title: Sr. Product Manager, Alexa Japan
descriptionHtml:
Alexa Japan Product owns the Alexa+ experience for customers in Japan. We work closely with product, engineering, applied science, business development, and marketing teams across Amazon to make sure Alexa+ works even better for Japan than it does in any other locale. The decisions you make will reach millions of customers across Japan.

Alexa+ is the next generation of Alexa, rebuilt on large language models. We are bringing it to customers in Japan, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class AI assistant works in one of the most demanding and quality-conscious markets.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own a core part of the Alexa+ experience in Japan. You will own the roadmap for your product area, decide what needs to be built and in what order, and hold the bar for what a good experience looks like for Japanese customers.

Part of holding that bar is defining it: you will build the test cases that specify how the product should behave across the range of things Japanese customers ask for. When something does not work, you will dig into it yourself — reproduce the issue, narrow down where it breaks, and work with engineers and scientists to scope the fix.

You will spend time on which problems are worth solving, how to solve them, and what is needed to convince the right stakeholders to invest. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, fluent enough technically to hold their own in a design review, and native in Japanese. You do not need a background in linguistics or machine learning research. You do need strong product judgment and the willingness to get into technical and linguistic details.



Key job responsibilities

• Own the product roadmap and requirements for your area. Define the customer experience, write the specs and PR/FAQs, and set the success metrics.
• Design the acceptance tests that define the product. Build the taxonomy of use cases and utterances your area has to support, write the seed test cases yourself, then use AI tooling to expand them into the hundreds or thousands of cases needed to prove the experience holds up.
• Prioritize ruthlessly. Decide what absolutely needs to be built, what can be cut, and which quality bars are non-negotiable. Make the trade-offs between time, effort, and scope explicit.
• Investigate product defects and quality issues. Reproduce them, isolate root cause with engineering and science partners, and turn findings into scoped, prioritized work.
• Partner day-to-day with engineering, applied science, and marketing teams. Translate customer needs into technical requirements and align stakeholders on the plan.
• Represent the Japanese customer. Use your own judgment of the language and cultural context to catch problems that metrics alone will not surface.
• Define the KPIs for your area, own launch readiness including go/no-go criteria, and report progress, risks, and decisions to senior leadership.


Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- 5+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Experience investigating product defects and quality issues and driving them to resolution with engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Master's degree or above in an advanced technical degree field
- Experience selling AI/ML solutions
- Experience managing and delivering product quality or testing
- Experience with competitive benchmarking and turning the findings into product requirements

title: Meteorologist, WWOS Resilience
descriptionHtml:
Join an innovative team that delivers tailored products and services to protect our customers and business operations. The mission of Amazon World Wide Operations Security (WWOS) is to mitigate security and operational risks and impact to our associates, operations, assets, and brand.
Amazon is looking for a Meteorologist (London based) in support of our Global Risk and Resilience team.

The Meteorologist, a member of the WWOS Meteorology team, will be an individual contributor (IC) responsible for (1) producing tactical meteorological forecast products in support of logistics operations across the EU and Rest of the World (RoTW) regions; (2) providing weather briefing support to operations stakeholders during large-scale disruptive weather events; and (3) end-to-end management of complex weather-related projects that strategically impact Amazon's Life and Safety, Operations, and Brand.

In this role, you will proactively identify, analyse, and inform relevant weather and climate trends and translate customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. You will leverage OSINT, climate radar and satellite imagery, and tradecraft to identify emerging threats, and produce written and oral briefs that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar, always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.

The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate good judgment while under pressure. The candidate will also be expected to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles and data analysis to identify problems and initiate actions to address them.
This position will occasionally require working outside of normal business hours.

Key job responsibilities
• Conduct comprehensive meteorological risk analysis using advanced forecasting techniques and meteorological data systems to identify potential impacts to Amazon's operations across EU and RoTW regions
• Collect, analyze, and interpret climate data, radar, and satellite imagery using statistical methods and impact models
• Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and produce written and oral briefs, in a cohesive and concise format, to serve customers across business lines
• Monitor, forecast, and effectively communicate weather, water, and climate hazards globally, providing real-time analysis and recommendations during dynamic weather-related incidents
• Provide meteorological subject matter expertise to leaders and operations stakeholders at all levels during large-scale weather events, including support to Business Continuity Management (BCM), crisis, and security management teams
• Incorporate government-issued weather and environmental alerts and warnings into tailored weather forecast products
• Analyse weather-related trends and patterns to identify long-term risks and opportunities for improved operations resilience
• Contribute to complex weather, climate, and environmental risk assessments that consider operational vulnerabilities, historical impact data, and seasonal weather patterns across diverse geographic regions
• Engage with internal customers to understand their priorities and requirements, and collaborate with global stakeholders to establish clear operational risk thresholds and escalation paths that protect people, operations, assets, and brand
• Contribute to the development and implementation of crisis management protocols and response procedures across multiple organizational levels
• Design and implement automated solutions to streamline threat monitoring, risk assessment, and notification processes
• Develop and/or maintain advanced weather monitoring systems and information dashboards to track potential threats to Amazon facilities and operations
• Train and advise teams across the organization on weather-related risk identification, preparation, and crisis management


A day in the life
A typical day starts with reviewing overnight Kepler forecasts and any government weather alerts that have come in across EU markets. If Umbrella's automated run has fired overnight, we confirm protections deployed correctly and check for silent failures or coverage gaps. On a quiet day, the focus shifts to protection efficiency analysis, SOP development, or progressing the quarterly rules review cycle. On a live day, it moves fast. WWOS Met delivers an activation recommendation, we stand up the SEM within 60 minutes, populate the tracker, pull lanes via PRECOG, schedule the call, and start coordinating across EUCX, NetOps, and site ops. Throughout the day there are ad-hoc protection requests from stakeholders, weather reporting to distribute, and the constant balancing act of protecting DEA without over-constraining speed. Tuesdays are WBR day, which means the pack needs to land by Monday EOD with the week's protection performance, attribution data, and any callouts. No two days look the same, but the thread that runs through all of it is the same question: are we protecting the right customers, in the right places, at the right time, without slowing down the network more than we need to.

About the team
WWOS Resilience (formerly BCM) is the operational continuity function within Worldwide Operations Security. For weather, the team owns the end-to-end governance of severe weather response across the EU network, from meteorological intelligence through to customer-facing delivery protection. This includes the Severe Event Management (SEM) lifecycle for weather-driven disruptions, automated and manual protection deployment through the Umbrella platform (UDD/promise pads, transit time pads, and capacity constraints), quarterly protection rules governance, proactive weather communications to CX and operational stakeholders, and site closure processes for life-threatening weather events. The team works in partnership with WWOS Met (who provide meteorological expertise and forecasting) and coordinates directly with EUCX, ATS CX, 3PCC Quality, AMZL, NetOps Control Tower, and ECFT/NFM to ensure weather-related delivery risk is identified early, protections are deployed proportionately, and customer delivery promises are maintained. The operating principle is simple: protect the customer without over-constraining the network.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with monitoring natural hazards, guiding critical incident response, and supporting supply chain decisions
- Degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field
- Experience with radar, forecasting software, and spatial data tools like Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

title: Human Resources Business Partner , Worldwide Grocery Stores
descriptionHtml:
This role supports Whole Foods Market stores, within the Worldwide Grocery Stores organization.

Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

Team Member Relations & Compliance

Consult with and advise organizational leaders and Team Members on TM relations and related issues within assigned client groups

Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

Provide assigned client teams and leaders with training, coaching, and guidance to maintain compliance

Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

A day in the life
This is an in-person role. You’ll be on-site in our stores four days per week, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders and Team Members you support — walking the floor and being a familiar, trusted face, not working from behind a desk or screen.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.
The best HRBPs in our stores are the ones leaders and Team Members know by name — approachable in the aisle and the break room, not just in meetings. Strategy matters, but only when it’s grounded in real understanding of the people doing the work every day.

- Experience with HR processes and systems
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- 4+ years of retail or operations, or 4+ years of customer-facing retail, hospitality, or grocery industry experience
- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management

title: Buyer - Central Sourcing, Global Tail Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Procurement Central Services (GPCS) Sourcing team, you will drive proactive procurement initiatives specializing in unmanaged spend analysis, catalog expansion, and process improvement / automation opportunity identification. While supporting reactive sourcing as needed, your primary focus will be identifying and executing opportunities to reduce unmanaged spend under GPO (Global Procurement Organization) coverage, developing automation proposals to improve team efficiency. You will leverage AI-powered tools and analytical platforms to uncover spend patterns, build business cases for process improvements, and lead implementation of scalable solutions. This role supports operations across APAC (Asia-Pacific), NA (North America), and EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) customer requirements.

Key job responsibilities
Lead proactive analysis of unmanaged and free text spend data to identify high-value catalog expansion opportunities — developing actionable recommendations, building business cases, and driving implementation to reduce non-compliant purchasing across regions.

Identify, propose, and implement automation opportunities within the sourcing workflow — evaluating where AI-powered tools (e.g., automated RFQ (Request for Quotation) generation, intelligent vendor matching, autonomous quote reading) can replace manual processes, reduce cycle times, and improve output quality.

Ensure alignemnt with Category Management teams on sourcing strategies for recurring spend categories, leverage preferred supplier frameworks, and expand catalog coverage to redirect free text spend into compliant / efficient channels.

Execute end-to-end competitive sourcing events for opportunities identified through proactive analysis — managing multi-supplier negotiations, evaluating total cost of ownership, and awarding to optimal suppliers.

Develop and present spend insights, automation proposals, and process improvement recommendations to leadership — using data visualization and analytical platforms to communicate impact and prioritize initiatives.

Ensure adherence to Amazon's Global Spending and Transaction Policy (GSTP) and comply with GPO procurement policies, procedures, and payment terms standards. Serve as a compliance reference point for junior team members.

Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships with business requesters, Category Management, Site Procurement Operations (SPO), external suppliers, and cross-functional partners — proactively aligning on sourcing strategies and resolving escalated procurement challenges.

Drive delivery of key performance metrics (KPIs) including catalog coverage expansion, spend under management growth, automation adoption rates, savings opportunities, and compliance rates.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing spend analytics dashboards — identifying patterns in unmanaged spend, tracking progress on catalog expansion initiatives, and prioritizing opportunities by impact. You'll develop proposals for running sourcing events to increase Procurement coverage as well as proposing new automation workflows, AI tool configurations, and present findings to your manager on where technology can eliminate manual steps. Throughout the day, you'll partner with business stakeholders to understand upcoming procurement needs, and work on building compliant sourcing solutions that prevent free text purchases before they happen (reducing unmanaged spend and reactive sourcing efforts).

About the team
The Global Procurement Central Services (GPCS) Sourcing team sits within the Global Procurement Organization (GPO) and operates as a centralized sourcing function for Amazon's worldwide operations. We take on central sourcing opportunities, providing scalable, standardized procurement execution across categories and regions. Operating from three hubs — Barcelona (Spain), San José (Costa Rica), and Hyderabad (India) — we deliver follow-the-sun coverage across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. Our team processes thousands of purchase requisitions monthly, conducts competitive sourcing events, and drives catalog expansion to deliver savings, compliance, and spend under management. We are actively scaling AI-powered automation and autonomous sourcing technologies to transform how centralized procurement is executed at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business, IT or any other procurement related career
- Comfort with technology adoption and willingness to work with AI-powered tools and automation platforms

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience developing procurement or business process automations using AI-powered coding assistants, scripting, or workflow automation platforms

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Storage, AWS Hardware Engineering, Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

AWS operates the world’s largest fleet of storage servers powering exabyte-scale cloud storage services. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of storage servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.


Key job responsibilities
RFP & ODM Selection:
Translate technical requirements into ODM evaluation criteria. Build scoring frameworks covering technical capability, manufacturing capacity, DFx maturity, automation capability, and commercial terms. Coordinate technical deep-dives between engineering and ODM design teams during competitive evaluation. Compile selection decision packages and drive decision meetings. Transition to NPI with requirements locked and statement of work signed.

NPI Program Delivery:
Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, NVMe/SSD layout, power/cooling topology, and drive interconnects. Build program timelines with critical path analysis, risk identification, and milestone tracking. Own milestone-driven gate progression: manufacturing readiness, production readiness, operational readiness review, and general availability. Drive cross-functional dependencies across firmware, thermal, mechanical, and silicon teams. Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.
Production Yield & Manufacturing Delivery
Own manufacturing readiness gates and production yield tracking from first build through volume ramp. Monitor first-pass yield by test stage, drive root cause analysis on excursions, and ensure corrective actions close before yield issues compound. Track ODM delivery cadence, line throughput, and supply chain continuity.

Fleet Operations & Feed-Forward:
Maintain fleet-level program visibility: AFR targets, unsellable resolution velocity, and component lifecycle risk. Own the feed-forward cadence — ensuring fleet failure patterns, manufacturing yield data, and vetting escapes translate into requirements and test content for next-generation programs.
Dashboards & Mechanisms
Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection. Define leading indicators: unsellable inflow/outflow rate, NPI milestone velocity, first-pass yield by test stage, and component lifecycle risk. Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity.

Risk & Quality:
Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations. Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements. Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical storage services.
May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.


A day in the life
You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you lead the weekly feed-forward review — translating fleet failure patterns into test content requirements for the next-generation program. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and updating the production yield dashboard before the ODM delivery cadence call.

About the team
The Storage Server Hardware Engineering team designs and delivers the storage platforms that power Amazon S3, EBS, and other critical AWS storage services. We own our platforms cradle-to-grave: from architecture definition through NPI, manufacturing, fleet deployment, and end-of-life. Our sustaining engineers are the backbone of fleet reliability — ensuring that deployed platforms continue to meet quality and performance targets throughout their operational life.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent
- 6+ years of technical product or program management experience, working directly with multiple engineering teams.
- 6+ years of experience driving hardware development programs (servers, racks, networking, or storage) through full product lifecycle including design, validation, manufacturing, and fleet deployment
- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes, and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience coordinating complex server programs with ODM/JDM partners across multiple geographies, managing design reviews, manufacturing readiness gates, and quality checkpoints
- 5+ years of experience working with storage server platforms or NVMe/SSD infrastructure across NPI qualification phases (EVT, DVT, PVT)
- Experience driving root cause analysis and corrective action processes for hardware reliability issues at fleet scale
- Knowledge of server hardware development lifecycle: electrical/mechanical design, firmware, thermal/power validation, and manufacturing testing.
- Experience driving zero-touch automation or fleet health programs for large-scale infrastructure
- Experience communicating engineering trade-offs and technical risks in business terms to leadership.

title: Broadcast Systems Engineer, Prime Video Live Sports
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is seeking an experienced Broadcast Systems Engineer for our Live Sports Production Technical Operations team. This role spans the design, integration, and day-to-day operation of broadcast production systems and the underlying compute and virtualization infrastructure that powers them. You will support infrastructure powering live events across our expanding sports portfolio including NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, NWSL, and NASCAR as well as the build-out of new broadcast facilities on our Culver City campus.

You will be part of the core engineering team responsible for designing, building, and maintaining a state-of-the-art broadcast campus — working alongside network engineers, broadcast technicians, and architects to deploy and operate the compute and virtualization infrastructure that powers live sports at scale.

As part of the Prime Video team, you will work on projects that are fast-paced, technically varied, and high-impact, with room to experiment with new technology, take creative risks, and collaborate with exceptional people.

Key job responsibilities
- Work as part of a core engineering team responsible for deploying and integrating production systems — collaborating closely with network and broadcast engineers, vendors, and production staff to bring new infrastructure and systems online.
- Manage the full lifecycle of server infrastructure: procurement support, automated provisioning, configuration management, patching, and decommissioning — physical installation and rack/cabling work as needed.
- Administer Linux, Windows, and macOS systems at scale across production, engineering, and post-production environments.
- Maintain a systematic patching program across the full fleet: OS updates, firmware, BIOS, IPMI, application software, and hypervisor components — including patch cadences, testing pipelines, and rollback procedures that account for a live production environment.
- Approach every repeatable task as an automation opportunity — building scripts, pipelines, and tooling that eliminate manual work, reduce human error, and scale operations as our fleet grows.
- Manage and maintain Proxmox VE hypervisor clusters; deploy, configure, and lifecycle-manage remote machines supporting broadcast applications, media services, backend services, control systems, and engineering tools.
- Maintain and continuously improve a monitoring and alerting platform covering all infrastructure layers — compute, virtualization, storage, network, and broadcast systems — integrating telemetry via APIs, Syslog, SNMP with dashboards, threshold alerting, anomaly detection, and on-call escalation paths.
- Manage and maintain records for all infrastructure assets, including physical servers, network hardware, remote machines, and associated IP address space.
- Provide on-call technical support during live broadcast events; rapidly triage and resolve on-air incidents across the full infrastructure stack.
- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including as-built drawings, system designs, VM inventories, provisioning runbooks, and change records.
- Approach all system design and implementation with a security-first mindset — collaborating with Amazon Security on architecture reviews, patching compliance, and vulnerability remediation.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Broadcast Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- 6+ years of hands-on experience in broadcast systems engineering within live production or media infrastructure environments
- Linux, Windows and macOS system administration experience at scale
- Hands-on experience administering enterprise hypervisor platforms - Proxmox VE, VMware vSphere, or equivalent - including VM and container lifecycle, storage configuration, and HA management
- Experience provisioning and maintaining bare metal servers: IPMI/iDRAC/iLO, BIOS management, RAID configuration, and hardware troubleshooting
- Practical scripting and automation experience (Bash, Python, Node.js, or equivalent) applied to infrastructure tasks
- Solid broadcast networking fundamentals: IP addressing, VLANs, network segmentation, multicast, basic L3 routing
- Experience configuring and maintaining infrastructure monitoring and alerting platforms (i.e. Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Nagios, or equivalent)
- Working knowledge of broadcast signal formats and transport methods such as SDI (HD/3G/12G), IP media transport (ST 2110, SRT, JPEG-XS), or AoIP/embedded audio (AES67, Dante, embedded/analog audio, timecode, and ancillary data)

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience supporting ST 2110 and NMOS-based IP production environments.
- Experience with configuration management and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent.
- Experience administering Active Directory: user and group management, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP integration, and OU structure for production environments.
- Experience supporting or working in live broadcast control room environments with systems such as production switchers, routing systems, multiviewers, replay, graphics, and playout.
- AWS administration experience: EC2, IAM, VPC, S3, and Systems Manager for managing cloud-hosted infrastructure alongside on-premises environments.
- Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in a media or production environment.

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

title: TPM, Fwd Deployed Engineer, Business Innovation and AI
descriptionHtml:
The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team within Business Innovation & AI (BIA) is looking for a Technical Program Manager who builds. FDE embeds directly with teams across Amazon Global Operations Services (GOS), co-builds with them from day one, and ships working AI-powered solutions. Engagements range from short builds to multi-quarter programs. The impact here is internal: you build for the GOS org, not for external customers. We increasingly look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web-based interfaces with AI agents, so a lot of what you build will be agentic.

This is a hands-on builder role. We’re looking for people who are already shipping AI solutions with the current generation of tooling, not people who are newly exploring AI or have only done some prompt engineering. The engineers who do well here are hands-on with agentic harnesses like Claude Code, Kiro, and Codex, and are plugged into the AI builder community closely enough to know what changed this month.

What Makes This Role Different?
Most program roles ask you to coordinate other people’s work from a distance. FDE asks you to sit with the operational team and build the solution yourself. You take prototypes to production and hand scalable patterns back to the broader org.


Key job responsibilities
Build AI & Agentic Solutions, Embedded
- Embed with GOS operational teams, co-build from day one, and ship AI-powered solutions that replace manual workflows
- Look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web-based interfaces with AI agents, and build those agents end to end
- Build with the current AI tooling yourself, including agentic harnesses (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex), LLM application frameworks, and RAG, and take prototypes to production

Program Delivery
- Own the planning, coordination, and delivery of your AI programs, managing scope, risk, and dependencies without relying on direct authority
- Keep delivery moving across engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders

Raising the Bar
- Bring back the tooling and patterns that work, and help the team ship faster
- Document and hand off scalable solutions to the broader organization


A day in the life
You start the morning embedded with an operations team, mapping a manual workflow you’re replacing with an agent. By mid-morning you’re building, wiring it up with current tooling and putting the next iteration in front of them. In the afternoon you iterate with the customer in the room, then push the working pieces toward production. You close the day sharing a tooling trick with the team that cut your build time in half.

About the team
Business Innovation & AI (BIA) finds the hardest, highest-value problems across Amazon Global Operations Services and builds AI-powered solutions that measurably change how work gets done. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is BIA’s technical execution arm: a small, senior team with high autonomy and a bias for shipping. We embed with operational teams in the GOS org, co-build from day one, ship working solutions, and hand scalable patterns off to the broader organization. We don’t just automate the existing process; we redesign the work around what AI and agents make possible.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical program management experience
- Experience demonstrating software engineering skills in a previous intership, work experience, coding competitions, or publications, or experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP) and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems

- Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

Responsibilities Include:

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

title: Construction Manager Intern (12 months) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
- Observing the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards with the entire internal and external project team.
- Supporting the construction team to ensure that the skills and competencies of contract labor are appropriate to need and fit to undertake the work.
- Witnessing comprehensive budget, schedule tracking and forecasting which strives for frugality and accomplishing more with less while identifying and solving factors that may impede a successful project hand-over to Amazon stakeholders.
- Studying the coordination with the authorities that have jurisdiction on the project to ensure regulatory compliance and smooth job execution.
- Partnering with internal customers and external stakeholders to earn trust and engage as a team to deliver results.
- Insisting on the highest standards by supporting the team to ensure contracted resources deliver work meeting duration and quality targets.
- Supporting construction managers to ensure all internal and external team members maintain schedules and budgets.
- Supporting more than one project in various locations, with potential travel to project sites.

A day in the life
Location: London
Start Date: Flexible between March - June 2027. We don't offer 2026 start dates.
Duration: 12 months
This is not a remote internship opportunity

Each day you will be observing Amazon Construction Managers act as owners to ensure the safe, on-time, and in-budget execution of Amazon construction projects. You may be asked to participate in daily tasks in support of the team, which may include coordinating with contractors on projected changes and project status, ensuring contractors are meeting their contractual obligations, seeking sustainable and environmentally friendly solutions throughout the construction process while implementing Amazon's green building practices, and utilizing Amazon information systems to record and update scheduling, budget, and other key developments. You may also observe and assist in negotiating terms of contracts with contractors, all while driving them to meet or exceed agreed-to schedules and budgets. Additionally, you will observe and may participate in weekly architect, owner, and contractor meetings, providing input on root causes and corrective action.

This internship provides familiarization across construction, engineering, planning, project management, facilities management, and contract management — giving you a well-rounded view of how Amazon delivers innovative physical assets from design review through final hand-off.

About the team

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in Engineering, Construction Management or comparable field.

title: Sr Workflow Manager- Network Strategy and Performance, Network Strategy and Performance
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Workflow Manager owns end-to-end Workflow execution across Amazon Customer Service network for multiple countries and time zones. This role operates at the intersection of tactical capacity execution and network-level strategy, ensuring that staffing plans translate into accurate workforce deployment that protects customer experience and associate experience while delivering cost efficiency. The Sr. Workflow Manager leads a team of Workflow Managers and their Business Analyst teams, driving execution accountability, process standardization, and AI-driven transformation at organizational scale. They operate independently, managing ambiguity with rigor and judgment, and influence senior leadership through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that directly shape outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.

Key job responsibilities
Own the execution of network capacity plans covering short-term (4-week) and operational (monthly/quarterly),. Ensure Workflow Managers translate forecasted staffing requirements into optimized CSA shift schedules, monitoring network-wide staffing accuracy against plan and driving corrective actions to close gaps and protect service levels at scale.
Act as a cost owner for Workflow operations across the network, driving cost-effective measures across the department and organization. Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, providing accurate Year-to-Go labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets. Align staffing execution with budget constraints and outsourcing strategy to deliver best costs for customer support.
Own the governance of network-level Key Performance Indicators including Shrinkage, AHT, and PTL across all sites on daily, weekly, and monthly cadences. Establish standardized reporting frameworks that surface performance trends, highlight systemic risks, and communicate metrics impacting service levels, customer experience, and business processes to senior leadership.
CSA Wellness Strategy and Occupancy Management: Define and drive network-wide CSA wellness strategy by monitoring occupancy rates, schedule density, break adherence, and burnout indicators across geographies. Establish proactive intervention mechanisms such as wellness NPTs and workload rebalancing at scale, eliminating outlier associate experiences and sustaining long-term workforce health across the entire network.
Process Standardization, AI Transformation, and Automation: Critically evaluate Workflow processes across the network and drive standardization, operational excellence, and best practices across all sites. Act as an AI catalyst for the Workflow organization, designing team-scale automation solutions that free bandwidth, shaping the team's AI learning agenda, and demonstrating measurable productivity improvement. Build repeatable frameworks that prevent entire categories of scheduling and capacity execution problems from recurring.
People Leadership, Talent Development, and Organizational Scale: Lead a team Workflow Managers and their Business Analyst teams spread across multiple countries, setting clear performance expectations and providing regular feedback. Hire, attract, and onboard talent while ensuring rapid exposure and skill development. Provide coaching and career development to recognize strengths and identify opportunities to stretch and grow team members toward promotion. Build organizational capability to scale Workflow execution as the network evolves.
Executive Communication and Strategic Influence: Present analysis and planning recommendations to leadership independently, adapting communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic audiences. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews that meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines with conclusions tied to the working-backwards framework.


About the team
The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
The NSP team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an Senior Network Performance Analyst – AI Transformation to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years of team management experience
- 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Master's degree
- 7+ years of supply chain experience

title: System Development Engineer, Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

We are seeking a talented cleared engineer to help enable and expand AWS Marketplace into isolated and government cloud regions. You'll build the tooling, automation, and infrastructure that empower service teams to deploy into new partitions — from infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines to regional onboarding automation and operational support tooling. If you thrive at the intersection of software development, systems engineering, and cloud operations in high-security environments, we want to talk.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join the AWS Marketplace Special Regions Enablement Team (SRET), which owns the infrastructure, automation, and deployment tooling that enables Marketplace services to operate in air-gapped government regions. You'll work across the stack — building CDK constructs, CI/CD pipelines, AI-powered operational tooling, and automation that unblock service teams deploying into classified partitions where standard commercial patterns don't apply.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Development Engineer you will:

- Design, build, and maintain infrastructure-as-code (CDK/CloudFormation) for deploying Marketplace services into classified partitions

- Build and operate CI/CD pipelines tailored to air-gapped and isolated environments

- Partner directly with service teams to unblock their regional deployments and resolve environment-specific issues

- Drive automation that reduces operational toil and improves deployment velocity across regions

- Contribute to operational readiness reviews and region launch activities

- Troubleshoot complex cross-service and cross-region issues, researching root causes and driving resolution

- Leverage and build AI-powered tooling to accelerate operational workflows and improve developer productivity

- Participate in an on-call rotation to support mission-critical regional services

A day in the life
On a typical day you might troubleshoot a deployment pipeline failure in an isolated partition, build new CDK automation for an upcoming region launch, pair with a service team to resolve a region-specific configuration issue, or design a new approach to automate a previously manual onboarding process. You'll operate with high autonomy, own problems end-to-end, and ship solutions that directly impact when and how services go live for government customers.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

About the team
The AWS Marketplace Special Regions Enablement Team (SRET) enables and supports the expansion of AWS Marketplace into classified and isolated cloud partitions. We build the tooling, automation, and infrastructure that empower service teams to deploy Marketplace capabilities into air-gapped government regions. Our work spans infrastructure-as-code, deployment pipelines, operational readiness, and direct partnership with service teams navigating the unique constraints of high-security environments. We're a small, high-trust team where every engineer has outsized impact.

We take work-life balance seriously. The problems we solve are hard and the mission matters, but we don't believe burnout produces great engineering. We maintain sustainable pace, respect boundaries, and trust each other to manage time responsibly. When the team is healthy, the work is better — and we actively protect that.

This role requires on-site presence at one of our listed office locations five days per week. We believe that in-person collaboration accelerates innovation, strengthens team bonds, and is especially important for the security-sensitive work we do. You'll be embedded with your team daily, working side-by-side on complex problems in a fast-moving environment.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
- You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
- You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
- You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
- You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

descriptionHtml:

Comprendre avec précision les enjeux d'affaires et les besoins du client, structurer les problématiques et les formaliser sous forme d'exigences métier.
Identifier les exigences techniques nécessaires à la concrétisation de ces exigences d'affaires et sélectionner les services et algorithmes d'IA/ML les plus pertinents.
