title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Delivery Packaging , R2L Ops Integration Packaging
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We’re making history and the good news is we’ve only just begun.

In this fast-paced, high-growth environment, making data driven decisions is critical. The Procurement Supply Chain team supports nationwide forecasting and inventory management for Rapid to Rural Logistics. As a Supply Chain Manager for the R2L Ops Integration Packaging team, you will focus on supplier product roadmaps, supplier and distributor readiness to support Amazon demand, supplier and distributor onboarding and integration, strategical allocation and recommendation surrounding change management, supplier and distributor performance management, supplier and distributor capability development, supplier capacity, risk identification and mitigation. This role requires the management of new and existing forecasting modeling tools, scoping and creating project plans, coordinating and driving execution, and clear communication to senior management. Cross-team coordination, program management and procurement skills are essential.

A successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Ability to think strategically and execute methodically in a highly ambiguous and iterative business space.
- High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
- The ability to independently own and drive strategic communications (e.g., decision narratives, investment proposals) with senior leaders and executives.
- Capability to communicate with technical stakeholders.
- Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where continuous innovation is desired.
- Analytical and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.
- Ability to clearly communicate data insights to others.
- Lead expansion of a program across business lines, including defining strategy and fully owning program and roadmap for expansion.





Key job responsibilities
- Serve as supply chain Subject Matter Expert (SME) for a variety of non-inventory supply categories, and manage those categories from a procurement, readiness, supplier performance and risk standpoint.
- Be responsible for supplier relationships including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, risk identification and mitigation.
- Interact with business partners to develop, engage and lead supplier relationships for creating the greatest value in cost, security of supply, risk management, and innovation.
- Support supplier product roadmap and product lifecycle plans in collaboration with category procurement, packaging and ops integration to ensure proper supplier coverage, diversification, value and security of supply.
- Engage with Suppliers in a detailed, hands on approach to support every day, operational requirements related to inventory readiness, changes in components and technology, and reporting.
- Keep abreast of changing business requirements and market conditions, and manage suppliers and contracts to maintain value and competitiveness.
- Perform spend analysis based on a variety of relevant information, prepare financial models, identify opportunities for efficiency gains and cost savings, and present business case and recommendations to internal business partners.
- Support the strategic goals of the business partners; act as a ‘consultant’ to help achieve those objectives. Be recognized by business partners for supporting their strategy and driving value.
- Spend modeling and forecasting, as well as financial management and controls.
- Support analysis and providing reporting on operational usage of shipping supplies to identify variations against plan.
- Support, develop, and lead supplier management KPI and metrics reporting, and develop and work with stakeholders to find and understand deviation and improvement areas.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to plan, organize, execute, and standardize complex projects to achieve 2026 variable cost and quality goals.
- Gather and analyze data across fulfillment and delivery functions to establish global standards for operations and other cross functional teams.
- Analyze and solving operational barriers with a focus on understanding root causes and driving forward opportunities.
- Have solid understanding of under the roof/on the road operational processes and the financial tradeoffs associated with implementing change.

They will work with product design/development, program managers, finance and category procurement for scalability of new product solutions. Key tenants of this role include being customer obsessed over customer experience, cost optimization and process improvement. This includes working with and through key stakeholders including Category Procurement, Program Managers, Product Managers, Safety, Finance, Tech, Delivery Experience and Operations.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS Solutions Architects collaborate with AWS Sales and other AWS teams to help address customer business challenges and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.

As a trusted customer advocate, Solutions Architects help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and provide advice on strategies for migrating existing workloads to the cloud. You’ll help drive successful business outcomes across a broad set of enterprise customers through your passion for educating, training, designing and building cloud solutions.

You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy by building deep executive relationships and influence adoption and broad use of AWS within your enterprise customers. You will do this by mobilizing resources within AWS and working with our extensive partner network.

title: Sr Product Engineer, Power Gen, Power Generation Solutions, Global Ener
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of what is possible in power systems? We are seeking an experienced engineer with extensive experience in power generation product development and design, including synchronous and inverter-based technologies, to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers. We are looking for candidates with proven ability to influence technical teams, a track record of delivering complex products from design and specification through deployment, and a deep understanding of power generation designs.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of cloud computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

As a Senior Product Engineer, Power Generation, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert and technical leader within the Power Generation Solutions team for the evaluation, development, design, and deployment of primary, temporary, and backup power products and equipment. You will own complex and ambiguous problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will lead developing different power and energy equipment to exceed our customer’s expectations for delivering power to our data centers. You will seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering products and designs. You will have the ability to drive change and make a substantial impact in the systems our customers rely on.

Additionally, you will have a key role in defining, modifying, evaluating, and validating product designs against AWS’ strict requirements for safety, availability, cost, and sustainability impacts. This may include equipment selection and sizing, product design development, engineering drawings and diagrams, specifications, and participate in project development. Your technical expertise on will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, integrating new technologies, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.


Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Product Engineer, on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for the following:

• Developing designs and analysis of different power generation sources (including, but not limited to; diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, battery energy storage systems, microgrids, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy) to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
• Lead the technical development of power generation and energy products for different applications, including primary, temporary, or backup power
• Define the infrastructure, deployment, and operations requirements for power generation products you own
• Understand the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
• Interpret, evaluate, and develop Single Line Drawings (SLD) or process flow drawings, engineering layout drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
• Providing feedback to the Design Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers and to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades
• Provide technical subject matter expertise to peers, senior management and partner teams
• Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Being a leader within the group as well as within other teams
• Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
• Having fun and working hard!


About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience and knowledge of power generations equipment, systems, controls, including, but not limited to; diesel generators, distributed energy resources, gas turbines, battery energy storage systems.
- Experience with process safety, natural gas piping and infrastructure, and establishing requirements, reference designs, and technical direction
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, P&ID drawings, submittals, sequence of operations, and mechanical and electrical drawing packages.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Master's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
- 10+ years of data center engineering or operations, or 10+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Professional Engineering registration
- Familiarity with power flow studies, substation design, protection coordination, and utility interconnection requirements, emerging power generation and energy storage technologies, and power distribution for large scale mission critical facilities.
- Experience and knowledge of Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies, Layer of Protraction Analysis (LOPA), and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
- In-depth knowledge of continuous operating redundant electrical systems and power infrastructure. This includes but is not limited to; uninterruptable power sources, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches.
- Experience with gathering, compiling, and analyzing data to identify availability and/or performance risks within the design and operations of critical power infrastructure, including an understanding of data analysis methodologies and statistical techniques.
- Experience with developing solutions and executing plans on fast-track design/build projects and/or multiple significant upgrade projects
- Experience with commissioning and/or performance testing of critical infrastructure and the associated controls systems for mission critical environments
- Possess excellent attention to detail and communication skills in order to maintain high quality standards for being organized, setting priorities, meeting deadlines, and staying within budgets
- Possess leadership and problem-solving skills

title: WHS Coordinator, Workplace Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are committed to ensuring our partners provide a safe and healthy workplace and work with them to deliver continuous improvements and effective accident prevention programs. As our 3rd party operations continue to evolve in a demanding work environment, we are seeking a dedicated Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Officer to support our partners in managing health and safety risks and employee wellbeing. The ideal candidate will put safety standards into practice, lead projects to raise safety awareness, and support management's efforts to ensure compliance with all program expectations and applicable regulations. With your proactive approach, you will help drive a safety culture by conducting regular audits, managing safety metrics, and providing guidance on safety-related processes across our 3rd party operations. You will play a crucial advisory role for managers, helping investigate accidents, near misses and incidents to determine root causes and implement preventive measures.

Key job responsibilities
In this crucial WHS position, you’ll report to the Country WHS Manager. Tasks will include:
• Conduct regular site visits to evaluate safety conditions and provide recommendations for operational improvements
• Carry out risk assessments and safety audits to ensure compliance with regulatory and local safety procedures
• Monitor and analyze safety metrics, create reports, and review incident trends to identify areas requiring attention
• Support implementation of new safety measures and provide guidance on safety-related processes
• Ensure compliance with all applicable Amazon supply chain policies and local/regional regulations
• Lead safety discussions and participate in safety briefings
• Support incident investigations and ensure timely incident communication
• Analyze safety performance data to implement proactive improvement actions
• Support safety training completion and verify training effectiveness

About the team
This role is provides Workplace Health and Safety support to the Quick Commerce team. Quick Commerce (QC), also known as Amazon Now, is Amazon's ultra-fast delivery service designed to get orders to customers in under 30 minutes. Here are some key things to know about Quick Commerce: What It Delivers:
• High-frequency everyday essentials like groceries, fresh produce, perishables, and household staples
• Delivered from strategically located micro-fulfillment warehouses
• Utilizing multiple transport nodes including motorbikes, e-bikes, walkers
Where It Operates:
• Currently available in UAE, KSA and Egypt
• Growing rapidly with plans to TR and ZA

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of workplace health & safety (WHS) related field experience
- NVQ Level 3, or A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent)
- Experience in data analysis and reporting
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar.

About the Role

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life
Watch a day in the life of a Data Center Technician https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKi0LtjSO4M

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027/2028.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal .
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components
- You must have access to your own transport

Preferred qualifications

- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.
- An interest in computer sciences and information technology

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: Security Engineer, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
Join the team that helps protect the Amazon and our customers. The scale of Amazon and diversity of customers means your work would have far-reaching impacts across a broad range of industries around the world.

Our highly collaborative, global team thrives on flexibility and is committed to each team member's growth regardless of where they are. If you want to grow your interest in AI/ML services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, generative AI, large language models, and responsible AI - we're right here on the journey with you.

The Amazon AI Security team is looking for a Security Engineer to design security controls and help validate that our AI/ML services, applications, and emerging technologies are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. Your responsibilities include analyzing the security of AI/ML applications and services, discovering and addressing security issues, building security automation, and decisively taking action to mitigate emerging threats throughout a full secure development life-cycle (SDLC).

This role will provide career growth opportunities as you gain new security skills in the course of your work. Security Engineers on the AI Security team have an opportunity to experiment, learn, build tools, and work with teams building new AI/ML technology and services at a massive scale. Security Engineers at all levels have the opportunity to learn from and be mentored by those who are building and securing our AI services. A Security Engineer is also expected to be a mentor for others and be a trusted security advisor within the organization.

A Security Engineer at Amazon is expected to make significant contributions to the AI Security team and to multiple groups throughout Amazon. Security Engineers are expected to develop custom solutions to complex security risk problems and apply appropriate technologies while following security engineering best practices. This role requires a Security Engineer who can be trusted within AI Security and by teams throughout Amazon on at least one knowledge domain, while being able to apply security engineering best practices in a broad range of technical areas.

A Security Engineer must demonstrate strong Amazon Leadership Principles. This role requires the ability to foster constructive dialogue and seek resolution when confronted with differing opinions on security risks. Engineers in this role are expected to participate fully in the planning of the AI Security team and constantly seek opportunities for process improvement.

A successful candidate will need a combination of troubleshooting, technical, and communication skills. An AI Security Engineer must have the ability to take ownership and deliver multiple complex objectives which may include project and software development work.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Security reviews for AI/ML products, technologies, and services.
- Secure design, architecture, and implementation of AI/ML systems.
- Secure development life-cycle (SDLC) practices including threat modeling and security testing.
- Influence decision-makers and stakeholders throughout the organization in multiple teams to achieve a consistently high security bar.
- Lead penetration testing engagements and create new testing methods and exploits.
- Create security guidance and documentation.
- Develop security tools and automation.
- Develop and deliver security training and outreach to internal development teams.
- Develop and improve metrics that drive desired behavior and security outcomes.
- Lead security projects (including security reviews, tool development, and creation of new security practices) with end-to-end ownership.
- Support for mentoring, team building and recruiting activities

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking healthy harmony between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

We are dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on interests and desired growth areas, supporting you as you take on more complex tasks while your skills and confidence grow.

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language experience
- 2+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship) experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics), or experience in IT Security
- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics), or 2+ years of IT Security experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP

title: Software Development Manager, Security Hub
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security Hub is a new unified cloud security solution that prioritizes customers' critical security issues and helps them respond at scale. It detects issues by automatically correlating and enriching security signals from multiple sources — posture management, vulnerability management (Amazon Inspector), sensitive data (Amazon Macie), and threat detection (Amazon GuardDuty) — then turns complex signals into actionable insights through intuitive visualizations and automated response workflows.

Every one of those insights reaches a customer through an interface — and the interface decides whether they act on it. We're looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the frontend team that builds it, across Security Hub and the broader AWS security services family.

Our biggest bet right now is agentic CX: reimagining how security teams investigate and respond with AI at the center. That means a brand-new web app built around agentic workflows, and an MCP app that brings Security Hub into customers' own AI workflows. Alongside that, your team owns the console experiences for 5 independent public facing services — rare breadth for a frontend org, and a lot of surface area to shape.

You'll lead a tight-knit, distributed team of frontend engineers, working alongside principal engineers and senior frontend engineers who set the technical bar. You'll own hiring and growth as the team scales, partner with product and design on a large roadmap, and drive decisions on architecture, frameworks, and AI implementation strategy. Development here is AI-assisted by default, meetings are light, and work lands with customers fast.

You don't need a security background to succeed. What you do need is a genuine interest in working at the bleeding edge of frontend and AI, the ability to build and grow a team while shipping, and the desire to have fun doing it — all while delighting customers with the experiences you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Own delivery, quality, and roadmap for the frontend team's portfolio: the new agentic web app, the MCP app, and the console experiences for Security Hub and other Security Services.
- Hire, onboard, and grow frontend engineers across experience levels as the team scales against a big roadmap.
- Develop your engineers deliberately — assign projects based on what will make each person a better-rounded engineer and ready for more complex work, particularly in emerging AI areas.
- Partner with principal and senior frontend engineers on technical direction: architecture, frameworks, AI integration strategy, and the patterns that make agentic experiences trustworthy and fast.
- Work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to align on API contracts and sequencing before build, and to keep five services' worth of experiences coherent.
- Champion AI-Native development across the team — raising the bar on how the team uses LLMs and AI tooling to ship faster without affecting quality.
- Own operational excellence for production AWS console surfaces: availability, performance, accessibility, on-call health, and launch readiness.
- Represent the team's plans and results to senior leadership, and protect the team's focus and work-life balance while doing it.


About the team
We are the frontend team for AWS Security Hub and the broader security services family, owning the console experiences for AWS Security Services. We're a tight-knit group across Seattle, New York, and Boston, working alongside principal and senior frontend engineers who mentor and set the technical bar. descriptionHtml:

This role puts you at the center of Amazon Grocery delivery execution, where your strategic thinking and analytical skills will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers.

As a Program Manager II, you'll drive end-to-end program ownership for initiatives spanning a wide range of stores across North America. You'll work backwards from customer needs, diving deep into operational challenges and scaling innovative solutions that enhance delivery speed, reliability, and reach. title: Lead Acoustical Design Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you dream of working in a role where your talent with Sound, Acoustics and next-generation data center design can be merged? Do you want to expand your current knowledge of building systems while providing input from your previous experience? Have you ever wondered what it is like to be able to influence construction on a global scale? YES! Then keep reading….

In this role you will influence all aspects of acoustics and sound mitigation for mechanical design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our global fleet of data centers. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the various sound mitigation features that our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance-based design approaches. As an Owner, you will strive to ensure the acoustic features of our buildings comply with local ordinances and will work with our due diligence teams to identify, measure, study, and report on the local considerations around our data center sites. We expect you to contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our acoustical design standards.

Primary responsibilities will be to perform and oversee project-related work, such as building sound modeling, paper writing, and document review, including coordination with public officials to establish basic site infrastructure requirements. The ability to coordinate acoustical mitigation requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations, and to provide detailed construction specifications for all sound and acoustics-related trades will be expected. You will typically be responsible for the preparation of prescriptive designs for building acoustics and mitigation systems. In some cases, you will be expected to prepare or approve performance-based design elements as needed to support our goals. You will review all design disciplines to ensure they meet the site acoustic requirements described in our design standards. In some cases, you will oversee and review this work and in other cases you will perform the work yourself.

As the team’s subject matter expert, you will ensure that contractors have the information they need to build our data centers the way we expect them to, and that our operations teams are well equipped to operate and maintain them as needed to meet our goals. As part of this role you will work with internal and external stakeholders, including design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, and other service providers, as well as local building officials. You will be part of a global team, and you will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Driving improvement of acoustic design standards and project approaches across the organization.
• Work with third party design vendors to review concept designs and designs in progress to ensure they meet established acoustic design standards, local code requirements, and any other requirements of the Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs).
• Be responsible for providing high quality acoustic engineering advice on a wide variety of projects globally while working with global engineering teams to achieve alignment of designs and design objectives.
• Coordinating with construction, commissioning, and risk management teams to answer requests for information and value engineering queries.
• Be responsible for construction documents, code compliance, design and installation standards, water supply evaluation and assessment, testing, inspections, and submittal review. Meet with AHJs as needed to ensure approval of acoustical features.
• This position will require up to 25% travel.


A day in the life
A day in the life
• Participate in project calls to collaborate with all stakeholders.
• Review sound study documents.
• Conduct sound modelling of projects.
• Design mitigation strategies.
• Develop internal acoustical evaluation methods and strategies.

About the team
The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire Protection and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of Data Centers. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred qualifications

title: Operations Manager, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics team pioneering Physical AI through real-world deployment and doorstep deliveries. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn by gathering rich operational data at scale.

RIVR is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

As a Operations Manager, you will be tasked to oversee our RIVR’s daily operations at our Zurich site and ensure our business runs smoothly and efficiently. Our ideal candidate will be a strong project manager with excellent problem-solving skills, a background in autonomous logistics (ideally with a focus on the last mile problem), a deep understanding of business processes, and a commitment to driving continuous improvement. In terms of approach, we are looking for someone who wants to be hands on and work in a dynamic agile way to meet our ambitious goals for deployments and scaling. Operational Process Optimization: help to design, implement, and monitor operational processes and procedures to maximize efficiency, safety, quality and throughput. Identify and address bottlenecks and areas for improvement in our flows both in the field and remote operations. Supporting testing and release validation processes in partnership with cross-functional teams. Ensure operational and testing spaces are organized including hands on managing the fleet of robots onsite.

Logistics: coordinate flows of robots and spare parts across business sites, including coordination with external shipping providers. Also, coordinate with the logistics needs of the R&D team at the Zurich site and operational teams elsewhere.

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience. Come build the future with us!


Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team

title: Senior Trainer, AI Collective, Selling Partner Services- People Experience & Technology
descriptionHtml:
The AI Collective is the unified AI learning and enablement organization within Amazon's Selling Partner Services (SPS) and PXD PMO. We serve 18,000+ employees and 45,000+ associates with a singular mission: build the workforce of the future through evidence-based, signal-driven programming that keeps pace with AI innovation.

We are not a content factory; we are a signal-to-action engine. We build training only when business signals confirm the need, we measure whether it moved the needle, and we retire what didn't. Our operating model runs on three imperatives: feedback-driven programming, scaling through systems rather than headcount, and business transformation.
We are seeking a Senior Trainer who can own live delivery and facilitation across all proficiency levels, from foundational through advanced, while operating in a truly fast-moving environment where the AI landscape shifts weekly. This is not a traditional L&D role. This is a delivery operator and force multiplier who makes training stick by owning the room, building facilitation capacity across the business, and creating the conditions where people learn by doing. The instructional designer owns the curriculum and technical content; this person takes that content live and scales it through others.

The Senior Trainer will be responsible for leading train-the-trainer sessions for business AI champions, with measurable impact on training amplification and force multiplication of learning and adoption. They will also serve as a mentor for embedded alumni, ensuring continued skill development and sustained adoption post-training.


Key job responsibilities
• Deliver live training across foundational through advanced proficiency levels using curriculum developed in partnership with the instructional designer, adapting facilitation approach to audience needs in real time
• Lead train-the-trainer sessions for business AI champions with measurable impact on training amplification and force multiplication of learning and adoption across the organization
• Build and manage the facilitator pipeline, including certification, coaching, and quality assurance for federated trainers delivering AI Collective programming across business lines
• Serve as a mentor for embedded alumni, ensuring skill development, sustained adoption post-training, and active participation in the learning community
• Translate business signals into programming priorities by surfacing confirmed capability needs to the lead ID and collaborating on content sequencing that addresses what the business actually needs
• Own stakeholder alignment and delivery logistics, including scheduling, sequencing events
• Support and expand community-driven learning through AI Innovation Fairs, Communities of Practice, and peer-to-peer learning formats that scale adoption without proportional headcount
• Collaborate cross-functionally with business stakeholders, HRBPs, and AI Transformation partners to ensure programming reflects real-world application and that trained populations are actually changing how they work


A day in the life
You own the room. You can take curriculum you didn't build and deliver it in a way that makes people actually change how they work. You read the room, adjust on the fly, and make complex AI concepts land for non-technical leaders and advanced practitioners alike.

You think in terms of force multiplication, not individual sessions. Your instinct is to build facilitation capacity across the business so learning scales without you in every room. Train-the-trainer isn't a checkbox; it's your primary lever for impact. You measure success by what people do differently after they leave your session.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in management and leadership development, organization development, learning and development, group facilitation, training and training design experience
- Bachelor's degree in learning design, learning science, instructional design, educational psychology, or a similar field
- Experience leading training organizations or programs at a national or network scale
- Experience delivering products against plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, distributed-responsibility and often ambiguous environment
- Demonstrated ability to deliver live training to audiences at multiple proficiency levels (beginner through advanced) simultaneously
- Experience building scalable training delivery models that serve large learner populations without proportional headcount growth

Preferred qualifications

- Experience facilitating technical or semi-technical content to mixed audiences (you don't need to build it, but you need to own the delivery and make it land)
- Experience with facilitator certification pipelines, peer coaching programs, or federated delivery models
- Experience measuring learning impact through behavioral adoption and tool usage rates rather than completion metrics alone
- Track record of building and sustaining Communities of Practice, innovation showcases, or peer-led learning ecosystems

title: Mechanical Technician, Data Center Community
descriptionHtml:
What you'll do

Plan and deliver maintenance
Plan, sequence and deliver preventive maintenance across all your assigned data center sites.
Carry out hands-on maintenance, including filter changes, tank inspections, legionella testing, pump servicing, UV lamp replacement and fuel system checks.
Keep maintenance reports and planners accurate and up to date.

Troubleshoot and fix for good
Act as the first responder for mechanical faults and carry out first-level troubleshooting to restore service quickly and safely.
Lead root cause analysis on failures and make sure remediation is completed so issues don't come back.
Prioritize tasks and manage work through ticketing systems so critical issues are handled first.

Own your assets and spares
Enter and manage asset, work order and maintenance history data in the EAM system for your assigned equipment.
Identify, buy and store the spares and parts needed for planned and reactive work, so downtime is never caused by a missing part.

Lead safely and raise the bar
Write and apply risk assessments and method statements (RAMS) for all your work
Supervise contractors who do servicing and preventive maintenance and hold them to Amazon's safety and quality standards.
Mentor on-site Engineering Operations Technicians so they can respond confidently to mechanical events
Look for ways to cut energy and operating costs without lowering reliability, and own your ideas from start to finish.

*How you'll work*
You'll normally work Monday to Friday during standard office hours. You'll also join an on-call rotation and work outside hours when operations need it. You'll travel regularly between data center sites in the cluster.

*Who you'll work with*
You'll join a diverse team of operations engineers, supply chain specialists, mechanical field engineers and site construction. Together you'll deliver the highest availability at the lowest possible cost. Our culture is inclusive: we value curiosity, ownership and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Key job responsibilities
What you'll do
Equipment reliability: Operate and maintain all of the equipment above across your assigned data centers, so every system is ready when it's needed.
Preventive maintenance: Plan, coordinate and carry out scheduled maintenance, including filter changes, belt and bearing checks, pump and fan inspections, UV lamp replacement, water quality checks and fuel system testing, so issues are caught before they reach customers.
Troubleshooting and root cause: Diagnose electrical, mechanical and controls faults hands-on, find the true root cause and deliver lasting fixes, not just workarounds.
Reactive response: Respond quickly and safely to equipment failures and alarms, and restore service with minimal impact.
Water and fuel readiness: Keep water tanks and UV treatment systems hygienic and compliant, and keep fuel systems clean, full and ready for generator backup at any moment.
Cost and innovation: Look for ways to cut energy and operating costs without lowering reliability. Bold ideas are welcome, and you'll own them from start to finish.
Safety and compliance: Meet the highest safety, environmental and regulatory standards on every task, especially when working with fuel, pressurized water systems and at height on rooftop equipment.

A day in the life
Most of your time goes to hands-on work, such as replacing AHU filters, inspecting a water tank, running a legionella test or servicing a pump, all under the risk assessments and method statements you've written. Some days you might travel to another site to supervise a contractor's maintenance visit, help site operations team through an unfamiliar AHU fault, or dig into the root cause of last week's failure. Before you finish, you update EAM and send your operational assessment to the Chief Engineers. No two days are the same, but each one adds to the 99.999% uptime that AWS customers rely on.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience within the mechanical equipment field. (Pumps, engines, cooling systems etc)
- Ability to travel between all nominated sites on a daily or weekly basis.
- EU Drivers license.

Preferred qualifications

- Particular experience in cooling systems (AHUs, CRAHUs, HVAC systems, Generators, Pumps, industrial water systems) is advantageous.
- Demonstrated capability in understanding and troubleshooting of cooling equipment and fundamentals.
- Training or certification in cooling systems a strong benefit.

title: Operations Human Resources Partner Intern (6 Months) - 2027
descriptionHtml:

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep.

You’ll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You’ll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day.

Here, the impact of what you build isn’t abstract, it’s visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world’s most complex operations moving forward.

This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

Key job responsibilities
- Developing in-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazon's fast-paced operations

- Assisting with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries, promoting collaboration and information-sharing

- Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth

- Learning about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and staying up-to-date on best practices

- Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision-making

- Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities

A day in the life
Every day is a little different as an Operations Human Resources Partner Intern. This internship will immerse you in HR within a global organisation, with the opportunity to work on projects across different HR areas — from employee relations and training to compensation and workforce analytics. You might spend your morning analysing workforce data to identify trends and build recommendations for your team, then spend your afternoon supporting an employee relations case or collaborating with operations leaders on a training initiative.

Amazon's HR function is deeply embedded in the business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve using data and analytical thinking to drive decisions. You'll apply your problem-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands-on experience. With a dedicated mentor guiding your development throughout the programme, you'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organisational excellence — providing a strong foundation for a career in human resources.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)

- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: Design Verification Engineer - technical lead, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, and our Custom Silicon organization is revolutionizing how we deliver cloud services to our customers. You’ll be part of a team that drives innovation in custom chip development, directly impacting the future of cloud computing.

As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team you’ll be developing hardware solution for AWS data center including AWS Inferentia,Trainium systems - custom designed machine learning data center accelerator.

We are looking for a passionate Design Verification Engineer to join our newly formed team responsible for verifying high-speed I/O and scale-up/out components across the SoC. You will take full ownership of delivering comprehensive verification solutions at a sub-system/chip level, with strong emphasis on system-wide implications and interactions. This role requires developing and implementing verification environments using state-of-the-art simulation methodology. You will create robust test scenarios and collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to ensure thorough coverage of hardware-software interfaces and cross-module functionality.


Key job responsibilities
- Architect and implement end-to-end verification strategies addressing system-wide implications and cross-module interactions
- Drive unified verification plans across multiple environments, tools and methodologies
- Provide technical leadership for verification efforts, guiding architectural decisions and methodology choices
- Own the technical direction and drive resolution of complex verification challenges at sub-system and chip-level, providing hands-on technical guidance and effective solutions
- Guide and mentor team members on best practices, methodology improvements, and technical problem-solving

The ideal candidate should have proven experience leading verification efforts at block, sub-system or chip level, with hands-on experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing. Experience using multiple verification platforms including formal verification, emulation, and test-generation tools is highly desired.


About the team
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 8+ years of design verification experience using constrained-random simulation techniques (such as UVM)
- 8+ years of experience in testbench development including stimulus, checkers, assertions and coverage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing
- Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
- Experience in embedded development in C/C++, or experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience using multiple verification platforms (FV, emulation, test-generation)
- Experience with AMBA protocols, for e.g. AHB/APB/AXI
- Experience with interconnect protocols, such as PCIe, CXL and UCIe

descriptionHtml:

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任

- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。

title: Security Specialist, Data Center Physical Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Data Center Security Specialist (DSS) supporting our data centers across mainland Japan. In this role, you will work collaboratively with Data Center Security Managers to ensure the effective implementation and maintenance of physical security procedures. You will support Data Center Security Managers in implementing security standards and operational procedures across assigned facilities while assisting in monitoring and maintaining physical security systems and controls. Your responsibilities will include helping prepare and maintain security documentation, standard operating procedures, and participating in security system testing and maintenance activities. You will contribute to the development of security awareness training materials and assist in delivering training sessions, as well as generate and analyze security metrics and incident reports to support management decision-making. Working closely with security vendors, you will help coordinate maintenance, repairs, and operational needs while supporting security improvement projects and initiatives as directed by Security Managers. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in data center security operations while working alongside experienced Security Managers in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. The role provides a foundation for career growth within data center security management through hands-on experience interfacing with cross-functional teams to ensure security requirements are met.


Key job responsibilities
The selected individual will be responsible for assessing and enhancing existing security programs, where security tasks, strategy, and priorities may be defined or occasionally ambiguous. They will participate in recurring site compliance audits, reviews, and testing of new security technologies. Contribute to developing strategic goals for the cluster that can impact the entire region, and adeptly adapt operational plans to evolving security scenarios. Member will make trade-off decisions and provide recommendations for enhance risk and security events. Collaborate with peers and internal stakeholders, develop solutions that help your team meet objectives. Assist in creating mitigation plans for security events or unique operational activities. Additionally, recruit and interview new team members while actively mentoring others to foster a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

Support daily security operations and follow established procedures
Help prepare and deliver security awareness materials
Process security tickets and assist with metrics collection
Coordinate with vendors under management guidance
Learn and implement security protocols and procedures
Assist with security project documentation
Support security training sessions
Maintain clear documentation and daily reports


A day in the life
Execute established compliance processes with AWS policies, standards, guidelines and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Verify and approve access requests and building access requests.
Assist in procurement: Work order execution, submission of requisition request, Purchase Order (PO) issuance, and invoice validation
On-boarding (provision of Amazon laptop as needed), training and off-boarding of Security Vendor resources

descriptionHtml:
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) Sustainability team seeks a Sustainability Manager to own sustainability strategy and program delivery across Amazon's AMER corporate real estate portfolio. title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.


A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.
