title: Flight Monitor, Amazon - Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization.

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos). If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.
Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Prime Air is seeking a highly skilled and vigilant Flight Monitor to join our dynamic team. This critical role is central to our commitment to delivering packages safely, efficiently, and reliably through our advanced drone fleet. The Flight Monitor will be responsible for real-time monitoring of drone flights, ensuring operational compliance, and maintaining the highest standards of safety and efficiency.


Key job responsibilities
• Continuously monitor the status of all active drone flights within the assigned region, utilizing our state-of-the-art monitoring systems.
• Identify and respond to any deviations from planned flight paths or operational parameters.
• Ensure all drone flights comply with regulatory requirements and company safety policies.
• Coordinate effectively with the relevant teams to implement immediate response strategies to mitigate risks and resolve situations.
• Prepare and submit detailed reports on flight activities, incidents, and anomalies. Provide feedback and insights to support continuous operational improvement.
• Utilize excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills while maintaining a high attention to detail in all tasks.
• Demonstrate strong communication and interpersonal skills while working effectively in a high-pressure environment.
• Adhere to FAA regulations and Prime Air directives and processes.


This role requires the ability to carry/lift up to 50 lbs., stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.

title: Business Analyst, Operations Integration & AI Transformation
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Business Analyst who wants to replace manual, repetitive work with automation and AI, not just report on it. You'll work directly with operations leaders to find where a process is still done by hand, then help build the tool, pipeline, or model that replaces it.

You'll spot where automation, AI/ML, or a new application could remove manual effort from daily operations
You'll turn real operational problems into clear requirements an engineering team can build from
You'll dig into the data yourself - SQL, root-cause analysis, and defining the metrics that prove a solution worked
You'll validate that what gets built is accurate and actually gets used, not just shipped
You'll help take a solution that works in one place and make it work everywhere

Our team builds the AI and automation products that run operations across the Middle East, Africa and Turkey. We build once for the whole region and adapt by configuration, not by rebuilding, so a solution that works in one country can reach five.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.

We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.

As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.

Key job responsibilities

title: Law Enforcement Response (LER) Specialist
descriptionHtml:
AMAZON | LEGAL


Law Enforcement Response (LER) Specialist

Level 5 • Legal Operations & Compliance • Amazon India
Role LER Specialist (Paralegal II)
Level L5 — Individual contributor with team leadership
Team Law Enforcement Response (LER), India
Location Delhi NCR, India
Work model Full-time · Work From Office
People management Leads a team of 3 associates
Experience 6–10 years of relevant experience




About the Role
Amazon is searching for a smart, motivated specialist to join its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team in India. The LER team is a dedicated group of specialists responsible for receiving, reviewing, and responding to law enforcement requests — such as notices, summons, and court orders — received from government agencies and police authorities across different Amazon India entities.

As an LER Specialist, your principal duty is to ensure that these requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, while safeguarding the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures. The role sits at the intersection of law[ and demands sound judgment in challenging and ambiguous situations.

This is a high-judgment, high-ownership role. You will lead a small team, serve as a trusted point of contact for law enforcement officers, and help Amazon meet its legal obligations in India’s rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently — at times with little supervision.




Key Job Responsibilities

• Triage high request volumes. Receive, log, and process law enforcement information requests arriving through multiple channels, internal portal, the dedicated police-inquiries mailbox, the government portals.

• Respond lawfully and accurately. Evaluate and respond to each request in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, and in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures.

• Meet urgent SLAs. Triage and close requests in line with established SLAs and SOPs, recognizing that delayed responses can result in loss of customer trustin customers losing funds; periodically receive and process emergency requests on a set rotation, including outside normal business hours and sometimes overnight.

• Manage external stakeholders. Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement officers, Amazon employees, and others — including significant phone-based coordination with officers who follow up on submitted requests. Explain what information Amazon can and cannot legally share, and guide officers on legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notice requirements).

• Lead a team. Manage and develop a team of 3 associates who actively process requests; help lead the training and development of other LER specialists.

• Coordinate internally. Work with internal Amazon partner teams — some of whom run data queries to retrieve relevant information — and apply familiarity with data-retrieval concepts to challenge or validate the outputs you receive.

• Use the right tools. Use a combination of web-based applications and data-extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular request.

• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, compliance playbooks, and process documentation

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows and partner with engineering/product teams to develop tools and automation for legal compliance processes

• Spot patterns. Assist in the identification of patterns and trends evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests, and handle the most complex and challenging requests and special projects.

• Authenticate evidence. Sign and issue certificates / letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests.

• Represent Amazon. Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices as required.



A Day in the Life

You will start your day reviewing incoming law enforcement requests from government agencies for validity, scope, and compliance requirements. You will exercise independent judgment to determine appropriate responses, balancing legal obligations with customer privacy and data security. Because a large share of information requests you will lean on your team to keep the queue healthy, partner with internal data teams to retrieve and validate information, and escalate the genuinely hard calls. It is fast-paced, operationally intense work where clear judgment and calm, credible communication make all the difference.




Basic Qualifications

• 6–10 years of relevant experience (e.g., law enforcement / regulatory response, legal operations, compliance, trust & safety, or high-volume operations).
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work experience.
• Excellent English-language communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong judgment.
• Experience working in fast-paced environments and managing workload even during times of stress or escalated activity.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
• Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities at once.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues and manage external stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience responding to, or making, requests from law enforcement agencies.
• Demonstrated experience managing external law enforcement or regulatory communications.
• Familiarity with high-volume operational tools and data systems; comfort with data-retrieval concepts (SQL proficiency is not required).
• Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Written and/or verbal proficiency in Hindi and/or any other Indian language.
• Background in e-commerce, banking and financial services, or technology companies with trust & safety functions (e.g., Meta, Google).

Note: An LLB qualification is not required for this role.



What Sets a Strong Candidate Apart

The differentiating competency for this role is the ability to build trust with law enforcement officers while professionally pushing back. Officers can be demanding or aggressive, follow-ups come at all hours — including over weekends — and the right person stays composed, credible, and firm on what the law permits.
• Builds genuine rapport with officers while holding the line on Amazon’s legal and privacy obligations.
• Guides officers toward legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notices) rather than simply rejecting flawed requests.
• Exercises independent, defensible judgment on complex and novel request types.
• Owns outcomes end-to-end and raises the bar for the team through coaching and clear process.

Additional Information
• Rotation & on-call. This role includes a set rotation to receive and process emergency requests outside normal business hours, including overnight and weekends.
• Background check. Given the sensitive nature of the work, candidates should expect a thorough background check. A strong track record of handling confidential information with discretion is a differentiator.
• Education. An LLB is not required; demonstrated experience managing law enforcement or regulatory communications is valued over a specific educational background.
• Location & work model. Full-time, Work From Office, based in Delhi NCR, India.



Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We believe building a team that reflects the communities we serve makes us better at protecting them.


Key job responsibilities
• Evaluate and respond to law enforcement requests in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures
• Ability to periodically (on a set rotation) receive and process emergency law enforcement requests both during and outside of normal business hours, and sometimes overnight
• Utilize a combination of web-based applications and data extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular law enforcement request
• Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement personnel, Amazon employees, outside counsel, and others
• Assist in the identification of patterns and trends that might be evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests
• Handle the most complex and challenging law enforcement requests, as well as special projects
• Help lead the training and development of other LER specialists
• Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices, as required.
• Sign and issue certificates/letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
- Experience in business development and building strong client relationship
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and judgment
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues
- Excellent organizational skills, and ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once
- Ability to demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience responding to requests from law enforcement agencies
- Experience in making and/or responding to law enforcement requests
- Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Written and/or verbal proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Hindi

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Fault Injection Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) is a fully managed service for running fault injection and chaos engineering experiments on AWS. Customers use FIS to deliberately and safely stress their applications, uncover hidden weaknesses, validate that their monitoring and alarms work, and prove that their systems recover the way they expect, all before a real incident happens. FIS experiments apply controlled faults to targeted resources, guarded by stop conditions that automatically halt an experiment the moment it moves outside safe limits.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to own the design and delivery of the fault actions at the core of FIS. You will build the capabilities that safely disrupt production-grade AWS services, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS and Kubernetes workloads, and Amazon ElastiCache, and you will drive the resilience, scalability, and safety of those systems. You will set the technical direction for your team's software, advise senior leadership on architecture and roadmap, and mentor engineers across the team.

Safety is central to this role. A fault that is too broad, or that fires against the wrong resource, can affect real customer workloads, so you will own the authorization, blast-radius controls, and operational rigor that let customers trust FIS to break their systems on purpose. If you enjoy distributed-systems problems where correctness and customer safety matter as much as scale, this is a rare place to work on them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture for one or more FIS fault domains, providing a system-wide view and design guidance, and act as a key influencer on your team's technical strategy and goals.
Design, build, and release software at large scale for AWS customers worldwide, then operate it in production and keep it highly available and durable.
Build new fault actions and target types end to end: API design, authorization, execution logic, automated testing, and documentation, and safely evolve existing ones.
Identify high-impact, hard-to-reverse technical decisions early, and drive the team toward durable solutions rather than short-term workarounds, especially where customer safety and blast radius are at stake.
Raise the operational bar for your team: strong alarms and telemetry, clear runbooks, effective guardrails, and a healthy culture of incident review and continuous improvement.
Partner with the AWS service teams whose faults FIS supports to design integrations and land cross-team deliveries successfully.
Advise your management and senior leadership on technical trade-offs, and contribute to short- and long-term planning.
Actively mentor multiple engineers and champion engineering best practices that others adopt.

A day in the life
A Senior SDE on FIS is an owner of the product, not just of individual components. A typical day combines hands-on building with work that makes the whole team more effective: producing and reviewing designs for complex fault-domain problems, building and operating fault actions across the service, reasoning carefully about authorization and blast radius so an action can never exceed its intended scope, keeping a close watch on operational health, and unblocking and mentoring the engineers around you.

You will join AWS Resilience, working on a service that thousands of AWS customers rely on to make their own systems more reliable.

title: System Development Engineer, Battery Test Systems, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Batteries power that mission, and understanding how they perform, age, and fail depends on data. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to own the lab computing, networking, and data infrastructure that turns raw battery test data into fast, reliable, trustworthy insight for a growing battery team.

In this role you will own the systems that capture, move, and organize test data: keep networked test and lab PCs (Windows and Linux) patched and secure, and build, automate, and harden the pipelines that move data from local PCs to network storage to the cloud (AWS S3). You will normalize data from many tester types into a common schema, drive down manual data handling, and make the whole system more reliable, observable, and easy to operate. You will start by stabilizing and extending what exists, then take the systems in the directions that add the most value: bad-data detection and tagging, richer metadata and traceability, Grafana dashboards and metrics, and automation that removes toil.

Beyond the core infrastructure, you will build new capabilities on top of that data, including deploying and operating AI and machine-learning models over the databases to create new features for the team and our customers: turning large, messy datasets into predictions, summaries, and natural-language tools that let an engineer get to an answer quickly. As the lab and test fleet grow, you will specify the software, networking, and security requirements for new test systems and partner with vendors and internal security teams to bring them online reliably and compliantly. There is real room to broaden scope over time based on your strengths and the team's needs.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Administer and patch networked test-floor and lab PCs (Windows and Linux) to meet evolving security requirements; automate configuration and keep systems current.
Build, automate, operate, and harden data pipelines that move test data from local test PCs to network storage to the cloud (AWS S3), with reliability and observability as first-class goals.
Maintain and extend data-homogenization code that normalizes test data from multiple tester types and formats into a common schema for shared tooling.
Improve detection, cleaning, tagging, and labeling of bad or incomplete data; incorporate metadata into the database for traceability across test types.
Build and operate summary-metric scripts, Grafana dashboards, and monitoring/alerting for production and test data systems.
Deploy and operate AI and machine-learning models on top of the databases to create new features for the team and customers, such as predictive insights, automated data-quality checks, and natural-language querying and visualization.
Build and extend implementation-level tools and small applications that make test data easier for engineers to reach and use.
Specify software, networking, and security requirements for new test equipment, and partner with vendors and internal security teams to bring new systems online reliably and compliantly.
Diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and availability issues across hardware, software, and operating environments, leaving systems better than you found them.

A day in the life
You might start the morning confirming overnight test data landed cleanly in S3 and triaging a pipeline alert, then pair with a cell test engineer to fold a new tester's output into the common schema. In the afternoon you could automate a manual data-handling step, tune a Grafana dashboard and its alerts, prototype a model that flags suspect data before it reaches the database, and scope the network and security requirements for a tester arriving next month. The mix shifts with the team's priorities, and you decide where your time creates the most leverage.

About the team
We are the battery team behind Amazon Leo's power systems. We design, build, and test the cells and packs that keep satellites running, and we rely on a fast-growing body of test data to understand how they perform. This role owns the computing, networking, and data backbone the whole team depends on, and works closely with cell test, build, and design engineers to keep the systems reliable and remove the barriers between people and answers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- Experience in systems administration (Linux/Windows)
- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- Experience including, building and maintaining data flows and pipelines
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

descriptionHtml:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems engineers with a strong background in cloud operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

- Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
- Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
- Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.

A day in the life
Embark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, you offer constructive feedback on change management documents and work earnestly to address your team's operational backlog. Through a collaborative effort, you strive to navigate challenges and ensure the seamless functionality of your systems. Additionally, you engage in the development and testing of scripts, hoping to provide practical solutions to enhance your workflows.

Beyond the technical aspects, you assume a role as an educator, sharing insights on the complexities of the European Sovereign Cloud with service teams. It's a humbling experience for you to contribute to the collective knowledge of the team, fostering a culture of mutual understanding.

This week encapsulates your commitment to continuous learning and improvement, acknowledging that every effort, no matter how small, contributes to the collective success of your team and the reliability of your software systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, your position involves 24x7 on-call responsibility. You work as a team to root-cause issues and ensure your systems remain resilient and fault-tolerant, underscoring your commitment to maintaining operational excellence.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the MX Supply Chain BI team, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that power decisions across Mexico's Supply Chain — from network planning and capacity to last mile operations. You will work with large-scale datasets on AWS, write production-grade Python code, deploy cloud-based solutions, and partner with stakeholders across 10 functional areas to deliver insights that drive operational performance. You will contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform and help embed GenAI and ML capabilities into the analytics portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/big-data pipelines using AWS services following medallion-architecture best practices

Write production-grade Python code for data transformation, automation, statistical analysis, and integration with AI/ML workflows

Build high quality datasets with robust metadata for agents to consume and give insights to our stakeholders.

Deploy and manage cloud-native data solutions on AWS through infrastructure-as-code based deployments.

Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain functional areas (Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Sort Centers, Operations) to translate business questions into analytical solutions

Contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS), ensuring data quality, governance, and single-source-of-truth standards

Write and optimize complex queries on SQL, Spark SQL and PySpark across large-scale datasets to support reporting, ad-hoc analysis, and metric development

Establish and follow engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, monitoring, documentation, and logging best practices.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve data availability, reduce time-to-insight, and automate manual reporting processes

Support the team's GenAI/ML initiatives by preparing governed, high-quality datasets and contributing to data products that enable agentic and self-service AI workflows

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality alerts from overnight ETL runs. By mid-morning, you're deep in Python — building a new data transformation module. After a quick stand-up with your peers, you jump into a working session with a Last Mile stakeholder who needs a new metric added to their operational dashboard; you scope the requirement, write the code and push for your peers to review before lunch.

You wrap up the day by prototyping a data integration that will expose a new dataset to the team's GenAI agent through the MCP — a small step that will let operations leaders ask natural-language questions about network speed and compliance. No two days are the same, but every day your work makes Supply Chain decisions faster, smarter, and more trusted.

About the team


MX Supply Chain Business Insights owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil.

Our team works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics, while also developing full stack applications to gather and process data. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling
- 3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business
- Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
- Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in an industrial environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Vulnerability Management - Remediation Engineering (PitCrew), Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew), AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM)
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) is accountable for the end to end vulnerability lifecycle across all of AWS: finding, contextualizing, and assessing vulnerabilities, and driving remediation at machine speed, without manual work from builders and at the lowest cost to AWS.

The Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew) builds and operates the capabilities that close the gap between a finding being known and it being gone. Our mandate is to automate mitigation, remediation, and assessment. We develop capabilities for mitigation and remediation outside of patching: recognizing potentially vulnerable and unused software components and retiring them on behalf of service teams, delivering remediations to builders as changes they can review and approve, and acting on hosts and their payloads within minutes when a patch is unavailable or too slow. We also build the tooling AVM security engineers use to codify, classify, and track the blockers that keep service teams from remediating on time, and the automation behind assessment and attestation: contextualizing findings with asset-level signals such as network reachability and compensating controls so that severity reflects true risk and every critical finding is a true critical, attesting to accepted residual risk, and generating evidence of those decisions continuously for auditors and customers.

As a Software Development Engineer II on PitCrew, you will design, build, and operate services that act on hosts and containers across AWS at fleet scale. You will own features end to end: working with security engineers to understand a problem, writing the design, implementing it, deploying it, and operating what you ship. The work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, host and container internals, and security, and much of it is about making changes to production systems safely and reversibly at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and operate services and automation that mitigate, remediate, and assess vulnerabilities across AWS fleets, reducing the attack surface and mean time to remediate without a human in the loop.
- Build the contextualization that turns raw findings into accurate, prioritized risk for builders, so service teams act on true criticals first.
- Own the full lifecycle of your software: requirements, design reviews, implementation, testing, deployment, metrics, alarms, and on-call.
- Build tooling that security engineers use daily, and work closely with them to turn investigation, remediation, assessment, and attestation workflows into software.
- Make changes to production hosts and containers safe by default: reversible, observable, attested, and gated appropriately.
- Raise the bar on operational excellence through metrics, dashboards, and continuous improvement of the systems you own.
- Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team's technical direction through design reviews and documentation.

title: Junior Formal Verification Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, part of AWS, designs the silicon behind AWS infrastructure, including AWS Graviton processors and the AWS Nitro System. What you prove here runs in millions of servers worldwide.

Formal verification is everywhere in our projects. Each project has hundreds of formal environments, from small blocks with sophisticated data crunching or complex FSMs up to chip-fabric deadlock verification.

The Role:
As a Formal Verification Engineer, you'll own FV for blocks within a Graviton or Nitro subsystem, end to end from architecture to sign-off. You'll work with technical leads and serve as a mentor and knowledge source for other engineers.

Your Ideas Shape the Team:
If a technique works, we adopt it, whoever proposed it. We're pushing AI and agentic flows into everyday verification work, and your ideas will decide how far it goes. Senior engineers on our team are co-inventors on formal verification patents.

What We Offer: A role we count on: formal results drive sign-off decisions, and other teams plan around them

Involvement from day one:
FV engineers join at architecture, define what must be proven, and shape designs to be provable before RTL is written.

A real partnership with design: we define verification intent together

A team where senior FV leaders work alongside early-career engineers who bring energy and fresh ideas.
We like the work, and we like working together.

Key job responsibilities
* Own formal verification of your blocks from architecture through sign-off
* Write the formal plan and define what must be proven
* Build formal environments covering FPV, sequential equivalence, connectivity, X-prop, security, and liveness
* Solve convergence problems with abstraction, invariants, and decomposition
* Report clearly what is proven, what is bounded, and what is still open
* Work with design teams to define verification intent and improve design quality
* Bring new techniques, including AI and agentic flows, into team flows

A day in the life
In this role, you'll engage in pre-silicon verification work that connects every phase of our product development journey- from initial product definition through firmware and software development.
You'll collaborate with hardware designers, software engineers, and cross-functional teams to validate complex semiconductor architectures and protocols.
Your days might include developing and executing verification test plans, analyzing simulation results, troubleshooting design issues, and participating in design reviews.
You'll work with advanced verification methodologies and tools, gaining exposure to cutting-edge technologies that define the next generation of cloud infrastructure.

About the team
We are a collaborative verification team that serves as the connective tissue across our entire product development lifecycle. Our mission is to ensure the reliability and performance of innovative semiconductor platforms that power AWS services globally. We work closely with hardware design, firmware, and software teams to validate complex systems before they reach production. We're committed to continuous improvement and seek opportunities to enhance our verification processes and deliver better solutions to our customers. Joining our team means becoming part of a group dedicated to technical excellence and supporting the infrastructure that enables millions of cloud customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Abstraction and complexity-reduction techniques
- Cover-based and semi-formal verification, and helper assertions
- Protocol knowledge: APB, AXI, CHI, networking related
- Experience or strong interest in applying AI to engineering work
- Experience mentoring other engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of the following programming languages: Perl/Bash/TCl/Python/
- Knowledge of PCIe, Processors, Ethernet, DDR
- Sound understanding and knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts
- Verilog/SystemVerilog/Specman

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be the earth’s best employer. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. The Protective Services (PS) Business Assurance Center (BAC) provides accurate, actionable information to the right people at the right time to support a safe, secure work environment. The BAC is the first point of contact for all safety and security concerns, the coordination lead for incident triage and response, and the knowledge manager for related data. The team delivers three core service lines: alarm management, incident response, and customer support. If you would like to help the BAC build a best-in-class organization to keep Amazon’s people, property, assets, and ideas safe, this is your chance to make history by joining our team.

The BAC is looking for talented security managers to lead delivery across all three service lines during their shift. A successful candidate will have a strong track record of managing operational security programs, vendor contracts and performance, and driving positive service relationships among a diverse group of stakeholders, partners, and customers. Success in this role will require flexibility, bias for action, high judgement, and a wide range of technical and interpersonal skills. Time management and continuous task prioritization is crucial to delivering support services in this dynamic, fast paced environment.

This role will require the selected candidate to ensure global Supervisors’ priorities are focused on supporting their Operators, and their success. The Operations Manager will oversee the service delivery of the global teams they lead, thus enabling Supervisors to focus on supporting their people. The Operations Manager will be an escalation point for Supervisors and their direct reports to act on issues or barriers impacting the customer experience. The Operations Manager will be accountable for creating the input, actions, and representation of team performance in standard meeting routines such as metrics calls with Senior Leadership. title: Data Center Controls Tech, Andrews, Texas
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager


Physical Requirements:
· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- High School or equivalent diploma
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites



A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You'll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites' equipment to make sure it's working safely. As an RME Technician, you'll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You'll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you'll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You'll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we're known for.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll be assigned a nodal home site that serves as your primary base. However, the role includes an element of travel within your designated cluster of sites. This means you'll move between locations as needed to provide maintenance support, respond to breakdowns, and carry out planned preventative work across multiple facilities. This travel element ensures our sites receive consistent, high-quality technical coverage and gives you the opportunity to broaden your experience across a variety of operational environments.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

- Valid Full UK Driving License is Essential

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

title: Applied Scientist II, Predictive Targeting
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about using data and machine learning to improve how Amazon reaches customers? The Customer Targeting team is looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science behind the targeting of Amazon's marketing initiatives across channels and ad formats. You will turn business questions into modeling problems and take your solutions from prototype to production, working closely with senior scientists, engineers, and business partners.

We are moving targeting toward outcome-based optimization and an AI-native, agentic way of working. In this role you will work on online optimization and reinforcement learning, incrementality modeling, and the next generation of our segment-based targeting model. You will also help build agentic workflows that make targeting decisions transparent and bring science recommendations to the people using them.

The right candidate has strong quantitative and statistical skills, hands-on experience with modern ML methods, and is comfortable working through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. You pay close attention to detail, learn quickly, and work well in a highly collaborative team.

Key job responsibilities
- Build online optimization (e.g., TSO, bandits) and reinforcement learning methods that optimize targeting decisions for business outcomes rather than proxy metrics.
- Develop incrementality and uplift models that estimate the causal impact of targeting, and use them to improve who we target and how much we spend.
- Improve the existing segment-based targeting model: engineer and evaluate new features, migrate it to new model architectures, and build automated feedback loops that retrain and improve the model from observed outcomes.
- Contribute to the intelligence layer of our agentic system: build components that explain targeting decisions and propose science-driven solutions to business partners.
- Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, causal inference methods) to measure the incremental impact of targeting changes.
- Write production-quality model code and partner with engineers to deploy, monitor, and maintain models.
- Present methods and results clearly, backed by data, with actionable recommendations for science and business stakeholders.

About the team
Predictive Targeting builds the systems that decide who sees Amazon's marketing content, and how often, across Amazon's stores and channels. We are engineers and scientists working on one shared problem: making sure customers see the most relevant and engaging marketing, and making each campaign better than the last.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- PhD, or Master's degree and 3+ years of applied research experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- Experience creating processes and improving tools that have measurably improved productivity, quality, or advertiser experience
- PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science, or experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
- Experience with reinforcement learning or online optimization in production, such as multi-armed or contextual bandits, exploration vs. exploitation strategies, or real-time pacing and allocation under budget and frequency constraints.

descriptionHtml:

title: HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People Experience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health at assigned site(s), serving as an individual contributor partnering directly with Field Leaders and site leadership teams. You will strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans, executing business goals through data-driven decision making, and partnering with campus leaders to improve the employee experience. This role is accountable for the end-to-end employee experience, owning site-level feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and environment standards that shape trust, engagement, and performance.
You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, supporting multiple sites within your region (campus) with regular mobility across assigned locations.

Key job responsibilities

Operational Excellence & Site Standards

Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and ensuring consistent, fair application of policies
Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Success comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered.

title: Innovation lab Lead, Fulfillment Centre Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for customers. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Summary: Amazon is a highly data-driven company that is passionate about its customers. As our operations network grows across Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres, automation is key to delivering orders on time, with quality, safely and at lower cost. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 is where new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, are piloted, tested and proven on a live floor before they scale across the network.

The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. They run the trials themselves, keep the pilot area safe, collect the data that proves or disproves each solution, and turn what works into standard work that other sites can adopt. This role suits someone with strong operations floor experience who is curious about technology, works well without direct supervision, and can get engineering, vendor and site teams moving toward the same outcome without having authority over them.

A day in the life
**Job Deliverables:**
- Pilot execution:
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan, including operating and testing the equipment yourself
- Set up pilot stations, material flow and test scenarios before each trial window
- Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen
- Safety in automation zones:
- Enforce the safety controls for the pilot area
- Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
- Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area
- Data and reporting:
- Collect physical pilot data (time studies, cycle times, downtime and fault logs, exception counts) according to the Business Analyst's data plan
- Check data accuracy at the end of each trial day and publish the daily pilot report
- Keep a live issue log (equipment faults, process gaps, user feedback) and follow up with Engineering, Controls and vendors until each item is closed
- Standard work and scale readiness:
- Draft and update SOPs and Standard Job Instructions (SJIs) for each pilot as the process changes
- Build training material and train site associates and teams on new equipment when a pilot moves to a live site
- Capture floor learnings for the deployment package that goes with a solution when it scales to other sites
- Conduct 4M and 5S audits on pilot workstations every day and keep the lab audit-ready for leadership and vendor visits
- Coordinate vendor and engineering teams on the floor during installation, trials and troubleshooting windows
- Work with site operations teams to schedule trials at their sites without disrupting their production
- Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
- Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver's License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.

title: Arquiteto(a) de Soluções - Enterprise Cross Industry, Brazil Solutions Architecture - Enterprise Cross Industry
descriptionHtml:
Você está em busca de uma carreira com grandes desafios? Possui curiosidade e persistência? Você quer se desenvolver em um ambiente inovador, onde experimentamos coisas novas e sonhamos grande? Quer fazer parte do futuro da computação em nuvem com uma equipe obcecada por ajudar os clientes?

Se sim, junte-se à nossa equipe AWS no Brasil como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções e ajude nossos clientes a mudarem o mundo! A AWS é a plataforma de nuvem mais adotada e mais abrangente do mundo, suportando milhões de clientes, incluindo startups, grandes empresas e órgãos governamentais.





Key job responsibilities
As equipes de Arquitetura de Soluções possuem 4 responsabilidades principais:
1. Atuar de forma consultiva para clientes. Em parceria com a equipe de contas, formular e executar uma estratégia para viabilizar o sucesso do cliente. Ajudar clientes a adotar os serviços da AWS e fazer o melhor uso deles, gerando receita como resultado. Educar clientes sobre a proposta de valor da AWS e participar de discussões de arquitetura para garantir que as soluções sejam desenhadas para uma implantação bem-sucedida na nuvem. Criar confiança com equipes técnicas dentro de clientes para que sejam cloud advocates.
2. Ser referência técnica. Transferir conhecimento para clientes. Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas na comunidade de arquitetura de soluções da AWS. Contribuir com publicações para o cliente da AWS, como whitepapers, postagens ou blogs. Apresentar e contribuir em workshops, grupos de usuários, vídeos online e conferências.
3. Estar em crescimento profissional contínuo. Manter a curiosidade e o aprendizado. Demonstrar seu aprendizado através das Certificações da AWS. Trabalhar com outras pessoas para ajudá-las a entregar mais. Participar de encontros e conferências.
4. Desenvolver e executar melhorias organizacionais. Atuar como um elo técnico entre clientes e equipes de engenharia de serviços para melhorar os serviços e recursos da AWS. Contribuir com suas ideias para inovação para times internos e clientes. Simplificar processos que podem ser simplificados. Ajudar a contratar e desenvolver talentos.



A day in the life
Nesta função, sua criatividade conectará tecnologia a soluções tangíveis. Você trabalhará todos os dias para ajudar os clientes a aproveitar ao máximo os serviços da AWS, para que possam inovar, prosperar e transformar nosso país. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender novas habilidades e aprimorar as suas existentes. Você criará e compartilhará conteúdo técnico, arquiteturas de referência e práticas recomendadas. Você divulgará e educará sobre a tecnologia da AWS.
Esperamos de você motivação, trabalho em colaboração com pessoas ao redor do mundo, disposição para enfrentar desafios, paixão pelo que faz e se divertir ao fazê-lo. Você deve gostar de treinar, desenhar e criar soluções em nuvem para um conjunto diversificado e desafiador de clientes.

About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos comprometidos em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos 13 grupos de afinidade globalmente, que reúnem os funcionários da Amazon entre organizações e países ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, alguns exemplos incluem o Women at Amazon, o Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e o Black Employee Network (BEN). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram as pessoas a buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender, ter curiosidade e ganhar confiança.

Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.

Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.

Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.

Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.
