descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Ensuring the safety and well-being of our associates at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in this area. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop within an international company. You will work closely with our experts to monitor your site, allowing you to see the impact of your work on everyone's well-being every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct risk assessments and audits.
- Monitor the site to ensure processes comply with Amazon's safety procedures.
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues.
- Collaborate with operations and other departments on safety-related tasks and provide process advice.
- Support the implementation of new safety measures.

A day in the life
You will work at one of our sites. This means you can closely follow what's happening and associates can easily approach you with questions during their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential problems before they occur. You will spend a lot of time checking the site and understanding how associates use equipment. By understanding how each task and machine works, you will be able to find the best way to ensure processes are safe. You will also be one of the people implementing safety changes, which means you will work closely with many people. In addition to your daily and weekly tasks, you will support our Operations team on one-off safety-related assignments. Safety is paramount at Amazon, and you will help us collect essential data that allows us to control our processes and anticipate problems. You will also share this data with company teams and collaborate with other departments to ensure safety remains the priority.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays an essential role in ensuring the mental and physical well-being of our associates at work. Our team works with managers, associates, and local authorities across all our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing safe work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Program Managers. Whatever your role, you will contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the network.

Basic qualifications

- Level 3 qualification in occupational safety or equivalent.
- Relevant experience using data analysis to generate and explain metrics.
- Knowledge of Belgian health and safety legislation.

title: Senior Risk Intelligence Manager, GRAMI Risk Intelligence
descriptionHtml:

Key job responsibilities

title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

title: Electrical Integration Leader - Power Distribution & Infrastructure, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution & Infrastructure to drive the successful installation of electrical power systems for automation and material handling equipment across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides field-based electrical installation leadership focused specifically on heavy wire pulls, power distribution infrastructure, conduit and raceway systems, control panel placement, and high-voltage terminations in complex industrial environments. The Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution will directly manage installation crews
responsible for all electrical infrastructure that feeds power to MHE systems. This includes
conduit installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels and equipment, cable tray routing, heavy wire pulling (480V 3-phase), control panel placement, disconnect installation, junction box and pull box placement, grounding systems, and wire terminations. You will ensure all power distribution work is executed safely, in compliance
with NEC/NFPA codes, and to Amazon's quality and schedule standards. This role reports to the Site Deployment Manager and works in close coordination with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — your team must complete power infrastructure in each zone before device installation crews can mobilize. This sequencing makes schedule discipline and quality critical to overall project success.

Key job responsibilities
Power Distribution Installation Leadership:
• Lead and manage electrical installation crews focused on power distribution infrastructure for MHE systems across North American facilities
• Oversee conduit and raceway installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels, disconnects, and equipment locations
• Manage heavy wire pulling operations through conduit including 480V 3-phase power feeders, ensuring proper cable sizing, labeling, and termination
• Direct control panel placement and mounting at designated locations per engineering drawings, ensuring proper clearance and accessibility
• Oversee installation of cable tray systems, junction boxes, pull boxes, and wireways
• Manage installation of disconnects, motor starters, overloads, and related power distribution components
• Direct grounding system installation and bonding connections per NEC requirements
• Ensure proper wire terminations with correct torque values, lugging, and labeling at all connection points
• Oversee cable management including wire bundling, cable supports, strain relief,
and routing compliance

Drawing Interpretation & Field Execution:
• Review and interpret electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, cable schedules, and electrical installation details
• Verify field installation matches engineering drawings and identify conflicts requiring resolution
• Partner with engineering teams to clarify drawings, resolve field conflicts, and validate installation intent
• Maintain accurate field documentation including redlines, punch lists, installation status reports, and turnover documentation
• Coordinate with mechanical installation teams on shared routing paths, penetrations, and structural supports

Quality, Safety & Compliance
• Ensure all electrical power distribution work is completed in accordance with NEC/NFPA codes, project specifications, and Amazon standards
• Perform and oversee quality inspections on conduit installations, wire pulls, terminations, panel connections, and grounding systems
• Verify conduit fill ratios, bend radius compliance, and proper support spacing per code requirements
• Manage electrical punch list identification and repair for all power infrastructure scope
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Ensure lockout/tagout compliance and electrical safety practices during all installation activities

Coordination & Communication
• Coordinate electrical infrastructure installation with mechanical teams, controls engineering, construction, vendors, and operations stakeholders
• Manage zone handoff sequencing with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — power infrastructure must be complete before device installation begins
• Track electrical installation progress, risks, blockers, and quality issues, escalating when support is needed
• Participate in project-level technical reviews, installation readiness reviews, and punch walks
• Manage relationships with electrical contractors, OEMs, vendors, and internal project stakeholders
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates
• Support development and continuous improvement of electrical installation standards, field checklists, and scalable deployment processes

A day in the life
Your day starts at the site coordination meeting where you review which zones have completed mechanical steel installation and are ready for electrical infrastructure mobilization. You walk the floor with your conduit crew — verifying raceway runs from MDPs to sub-panels against engineering drawings, checking conduit supports and fill
ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next
day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial electrical installation, electrical construction,
- power distribution, or a similar technical environment
- Experience leading or supervising electrical installation crews, contractors, or field execution teams
- Experience reading and interpreting electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, and wiring diagrams
- Experience with industrial power distribution systems including 480V 3-phase, motor control circuits, disconnects, and related infrastructure
- Experience with conduit installation, raceway systems, cable tray, wire pulling, and termination practices
- Experience working in fast-paced industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing journeyman electricians, electrical contractors, or industrial electricians on large-scale installation projects
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing power distribution infrastructure for conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with 480V 3-phase systems, motor control centers (MCCs), VFD power wiring, and transformer installations
- Journeyman electrician license, master electrician license, or state electrical license
- Knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Bluebeam, BIM 360, or equivalent drawing review software
- Experience with NEC/NFPA compliance in industrial or construction environments
- Experience managing third-party electrical contractors and subcontractors
- Experience with punch list management, redlines, installation quality inspections, and turnover documentation

title: Software Development Engineer II, Leo Antenna Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit. Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering reliable connectivity to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

You will design, build, and deploy embedded software for high-volume consumer electronic devices that connect customers to the Kuiper network. Project Kuiper is breaking new ground with every device we create, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement embedded software for terrestrial customer devices within the Leo system, working across bare-metal and Linux environments.
- Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle for embedded systems, from requirements gathering and design through coding, testing, and product deployment.
- Collaborate with hardware, product, and operations teams to translate device requirements into reliable embedded software using languages such as C, C++, and Rust.
- Troubleshoot and validate embedded software using tools like logic analyzers and schematic reviews, identifying root causes of issues and driving permanent fixes.
- Mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and documentation, helping maintain high code quality and ensuring new team members can quickly understand how the software is constructed and operated.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
Your day might start with a stand-up alongside hardware and software engineers, aligning on the latest board bring-up progress or a firmware integration milestone. You could then spend focused time writing and debugging embedded code, pairing with a teammate to trace an issue through a logic analyzer. In the afternoon, you might review a peer's design for a new device feature, then sync with the product team on upcoming deployment timelines.

About the team
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect customers to the Leo satellite network. We provide embedded application software and the underlying Linux system software for these terminals. We work hand in hand with hardware, product, and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers. As Leo moves toward full-scale production and global deployment, this is a compelling time to join and help shape how millions of people get online for the first time.

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security is seeking a Vulnerability Management Analyst to identify, assess, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across information systems supporting a high-priority U.S. Government program.

In this role, you will develop and maintain the vulnerability management plan, sustain an accurate asset inventory, and establish a disciplined patching cadence across the platform. You will run periodic security scans, analyze and prioritize findings by risk, and drive resolution of Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs) to closure. Working alongside the Information System Security Manager (ISSM), platform build and engineering teams, and U.S. Government counterparts, you will ensure vulnerabilities are tracked, reported, and remediated in a timely manner. You will also maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) as it relates to vulnerability and patch management, support audit review, and help sustain a valid Authorization to Operate (ATO).

This position requires U.S. Citizenship and an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the vulnerability management plan and supporting documentation.
- Build and sustain an accurate, comprehensive asset inventory as the basis for vulnerability coverage.
- Establish and enforce a patching cadence, coordinating with platform and engineering teams to remediate on schedule.
- Conduct periodic vulnerability scans, validate results, and prioritize findings by risk and operational impact.
- Drive resolution of Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs) from identification through closure.
- Track remediation to completion and report status to the ISSM and U.S. Government counterparts.
- Maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) as it pertains to vulnerability and patch management.
- Support periodic audit review and respond to ad hoc security inquiries from government stakeholders.
- Contribute to the development and refinement of scanning, reporting, and remediation processes and automation to improve efficiency.
- Help sustain a valid Authorization to Operate (ATO) by ensuring continuous vulnerability management.

A day in the life
Your day starts with the latest scan results. You review new findings, prioritize them by risk and operational impact, and update the asset inventory so nothing falls outside coverage. You work with platform and engineering teams to schedule patches against the cadence, then drive an open IAVA toward closure, tracking remediation until it is verified. Midday, you refresh the vulnerability management plan and update the SSP to reflect current patch posture. You report status to the ISSM and your Government counterparts, field an audit inquiry, and refine a scan report. Every action you take keeps the system covered, documented, and holding a valid ATO.

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. - Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Physical Requirements:

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Real-Time Conversational AI , AGI
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to drive the research and development of real-time multimodal conversational AI. You will operate across two focus areas: advancing foundation models for speech and audio, and building the post-training systems (reward modeling, reinforcement learning) that shape natural, human-like conversational behavior.

You will be the expert in your area while contributing across the full model lifecycle — from pre-training and architecture design through post-training alignment and real-time deployment. You will work at the frontier of what's possible in conversational AI, with the compute, data, and runway to pursue problems that few teams in the world have the resources to tackle.

As a Principal Scientist, you will set the technical direction for your research area, influence the broader roadmap, and work closely with inference engineers to ensure your models are designed for real-time production deployment from inception.

Key job responsibilities
Foundation Model Scaling

- Build and train large-scale multimodal foundation models for real-time speech and audio generation, from architecture design through production-scale training

- Advance the scaling and efficiency of conversational modes, including the relationship between data, model size, and real time performance.

- Design model architectures informed by hardware constraints and inference requirements, working with inference engineers to ensure models are servable from inception

- Develop training methodologies for multimodal models that jointly process and generate speech, language, and audio in real-time streaming contexts

Post-Training & Reinforcement Learning

- Design and build reward models and reward functions for speech systems — capturing naturalness, fluency, conversational quality, and real-time responsiveness

- Develop and apply reinforcement learning methods to shape conversational behavior — teaching models natural timing, responsiveness, and fluid interaction

- Build the post-training pipeline from SFT through RL alignment, optimized for real-time multimodal outputs rather than text-only generation

- Design evaluation frameworks that capture the quality dimensions unique to real-time conversation

Real-Time Perception & Generation

- Advance the team's capabilities in real-time perception

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to be part of an innovative and rapidly growing business? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a talented, customer-obsessed, self-directed builder to drive the innovation and enhancement of the Private Pricing Program through the post-contract purchase experience. You will join the Private Pricing Programs and Experiences (3PX) team, within the Global Deal Strategy and Programs (GDSP) organization.
In this role you will own strategic initiatives, build scalable processes and mechanisms, shape requirements for features that improve the Private Pricing customer experience post contract signatures, and lead cross-functional work that cuts across functions, organizations, and cultures — including Billing, Monetization, Tax, Payments, Legal, and Finance.
You will find ways to create a delightful post-purchase experience through the effective use of Amazon mechanisms (data, narratives, one-way vs. two-way door decisions). You must work closely with internal stakeholders and senior leadership to scope and frame transformations to the post-purchase experience, achieving fluency in both the Private Pricing Program and the processes that support our deal pipeline and post-purchase experience to deliver measurable business impact. You own complex, strategic initiatives with cross-organizational impact within the post-signature experience across Process & Governance; Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management; Seller Enablement; and Innovation & Continuous Improvement.

Define the metrics that matter, translate complex data into actionable insights, and deliver strategic recommendations that inform decisions at the leadership level. Coordinate initiatives across AWS teams, drive accountability through clear ownership and milestone tracking, and translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans. Define requirements for self-service insights and content that enable sellers to operate at scale, making correct action the default. Run experimental pilots to test interventions at small scale before full-scale implementation, and identify opportunities for automation that eliminate friction in the post-purchase journey before it compounds. Hire, mentor, and develop others, and raise the bar for the team.

The 3PX Post Purchase team is the backbone for AWS Private Pricing customers after contract execution — transforming defects into improvements, driving strategic initiatives and global expansion. Success is measured by defect volume, resolution time, billing accuracy rates, seller self-service adoption, and customer renewal rates.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer to join our growing Amazon Elastic Container Services for Kubernetes (EKS) team. Amazon EKS is our managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy for customers to use Kubernetes without needing to become experts in provisioning and operating Kubernetes. EKS manages time-consuming administrative tasks like setting up, operating, scaling and updating Kubernetes, freeing customers up to focus on their applications.

The EKS Networking team builds the networking stack that connects customer workloads running on EKS clusters. We own the VPC CNI, which runs in the majority of EKS clusters worldwide, and an eBPF-based network policy enforcement path that replaced third-party dependencies with a native implementation. We are now building a service mesh, an Istio or Istio-like capability (traffic management, mTLS, policy, and observability) that avoids the per-pod sidecar tax by leaning on the kernel and the networking stack we already own. You will be joining a fast paced team working on greenfield projects, building the data path for that mesh.

You will own how traffic is intercepted, encrypted, and forwarded between services, deciding where Layer 4 and mTLS live (a per-node proxy and the kernel) versus where Layer 7 processing happens, and owning the performance budget that justifies a sidecarless design. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you!

Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design the mesh data path: traffic interception, encryption, and forwarding between services without a per-pod sidecar.
- Decide where Layer 4 and mTLS enforcement live (per-node proxy and the kernel) versus where Layer 7 processing happens, and own the handoff between them.
- Own the data path performance budget (latency, CPU, memory) against a per-pod sidecar baseline, with measured results.
- Partner with the control plane, kernel/eBPF, and protocols engineers whose subsystems run inside the path you design.
- Raise the bar through design reviews and code reviews, and mentor engineers building on the data path.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Hardware Test and Integration Manager, OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Hardware Test & Integration Manager to lead a major share of the Prototyping and Integration (PI) Team. You will manage three engineering functions — Testing (development, qualification, and reliability test), Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration (harnessing, PCB fabrication, and related electro-mechanical build) — and the mixed team of engineers and technician staff who deliver them. You are accountable for the people, the mechanisms, and the hardware outcomes across all three.

This is a people-leadership role where the problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not yet defined. You set the metrics and long-term direction these functions run by, design the team structure and mechanisms that keep complex prototype hardware moving at quality and speed, and negotiate priorities across the organization when three disciplines compete for the same bench and the same week. You hire and grow bar-raising talent, build a team that delivers without you, and represent these functions to program leadership and partner engineering organizations.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the Testing, Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration functions of the PI-Team.
- Define the metrics, goals, and long-term strategy for development, qualification, and reliability test of OISL prototype hardware, and establish the mechanisms that make test results auditable, data-driven, and repeatable.
- Direct the team's electromechanical integration work — GSE and prototype design, harnessing, and PCB fabrication — setting the workmanship and quality standards the team executes to.
- Own configuration control for the team's hardware — ensure designs, drawings, BOMs, and test documentation are created, reviewed, and released through formal PLM structure and change control (Siemens Teamcenter or equivalent).
- Establish workflows, SLAs, and cross-pillar prioritization, and negotiate resourcing across teams when programs and disciplines compete for the same capacity.
- Build and scale process-improvement and operational-excellence mechanisms across all three functions.
- Partner with design, manufacturing, and program engineering upstream to influence hardware design and schedule decisions before they are finalized.
- Serve as the escalation point for cross-functional blockers, resourcing conflicts, and schedule delays.

A day in the life
You move across multiple labs in a day — a reliability test review in the morning, a design verification test plan midday, a harnessing or PCB integration issue in the afternoon. You spend real time with your engineers and staff: unblocking them, coaching ownership, and holding 1:1s that tie their work to where they want to grow.

When program demands create a resourcing conflict, you make the prioritization call and own the outcome. You carry status to leadership yourself, pulled from the work rather than reported up to you. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who manages through mechanisms, earns trust across engineering disciplines, and builds a team that runs well without them.

About the team
The Prototyping & Integration (PI) Team accelerates hardware development through rapid prototyping, manufacturing, and integration of novel Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) and systems for the Optical Intersatellite Link organization. Our service areas span Hardware Fabrication, Electrical Integration, Systems Hardware Development, DVT and Qualification Testing, and Quality Assurance. Our learnings are directly applied to scale aerospace manufacturing processes and enable risk reduction through comprehensive Design Verification Testing and qualification testing. We seek candidates who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments where ownership, operational excellence, and engineering-first approaches are valued.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
- 10+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience directly managing engineers and/or technicians, including hiring, setting deliverable expectations, and managing performance.
- Experience establishing engineering processes, standards, or operational-excellence mechanisms that a team executes to, driven to measurable results.
- Experience driving hardware through development and qualification phases (DVT/PVT or equivalent) in a prototype or low-volume development environment.
- Experience creating and releasing hardware designs and documentation — drawings, BOMs, and procedures — within a formal PLM structure and change-control process.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite, or other high-reliability hardware development.
- Deep working knowledge of at least one pillar — test strategy and reliability methods, design of experiment, or harnessing/PCBA and electromechanical integration — strong enough to set the standard and mentor senior individual contributors in it.
- Experience building out lab infrastructure, including executing facilities improvement projects and/or commissioning capital equipment.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

title: Technical Program Manager, Serviceability
descriptionHtml:
Data Center Serviceability team works with hundreds of data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.

Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle, encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to support serviceability for water systems across our data centers. Water quality management is a critical and fast-growing area of data center operations, where evaporative cooling, condenser water, and makeup water systems must be kept safe, compliant, and reliable to protect both people and infrastructure. This role will define how water systems are sampled, maintained, and kept within regulatory compliance as we scale from early programs to a global fleet, with a focus on proactively catching water quality issues before they drive equipment degradation or infrastructure downtime.

What you will do:

You will own the serviceability program for water systems across the fleet. You will write and maintain preventive maintenance (PM) guidelines for water sampling across all water bodies in our data centers, such as cooling towers, condenser and chilled water loops, evaporative systems, and storage tanks, making sure these guidelines meet regulatory and environmental compliance requirements across every region we operate in. You will build these guidelines with Operations, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), Industrial Hygiene, Environmental, and water treatment vendors. You will set the serviceability framework for water systems so that sampling, treatment, and remediation happen on time and water quality issues are caught proactively rather than after they affect equipment or availability. You will partner with Finance on labor analyses that turn sampling and treatment needs into staffing plans. You will work with Field Engineering to lead root cause analyses on water quality and equipment findings, and you will make sure the lessons feed back into PM standards and procedures. You will work with Operations and site teams to build operational readiness plans for new sites, then track readiness so every site is sampling and compliant from day one. You will also run field trials and stakeholder workshops to validate procedures, collect feedback and drive continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
Own the execution and success metrics for water systems serviceability across the global fleet
Write and maintain PM guidelines for water sampling across all water bodies, ensuring they meet regulatory and environmental compliance, working with Operations, DCEO, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental, and vendors
Set the serviceability framework for water systems that keeps sampling and treatment on schedule and prevents water quality issues from causing infrastructure downtime
Build mechanisms to proactively detect and escalate water quality risks before they affect equipment or availability
Conduct labor analyses with Finance to support annual and long-range staffing plans
Lead root cause analyses with Field Engineering on water quality and equipment findings, and drive corrective actions into standards
Build operational readiness plans with Operations and site teams, and track readiness as new sites deploy
Run field trials and stakeholder workshops to validate procedures and collect operational feedback
Keep serviceability standards current as the fleet grows and new equipment, regulations, and vendors are introduced
Use data and metrics to measure program health, prioritize effort and report progress
Write narratives (one to six pages) and present to Director-level leadership
Travel up to 10–15%

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, biotech/bio-engineering, mechanical or equivalent relevant experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing serviceability/maintenance programs
- Experience maintaining regulatory or compliance-driven global programs
- Experience working with data center engineering teams

The Director, GTM Operations L owns go-to-market coordination, readiness, and on-time delivery across the membership portfolio evolution. You design the GTM plan and working-backward timeline that brings the strategy to life for customers, and you keep the GTM team on track to launch through strategic problem solving, rigorous program management and clear communication. You run milestone reviews at the right time with the right people, documenting feedback, decisions, and open disagreements for resolution or escalation. When something slips, you catch it early and use sound judgment on whether to resolve it within the cross-functional team or escalate for a leadership decision, keeping momentum intact. You work across Product Marketing, surface and channel owners (GLM, Paid Media, Brand/Social, Comms/PR, CS), and measurement partners (Finance, VINCI/Econ) to deliver cohesive messaging and synchronized campaign execution that meets launch and performance objectives in every marketplace.

Because this role centers on marketing launch preparation, readiness, and delivery, you partner with the Product Leads and TPMs (who coordinate across the Product and Tech org) to land a synchronized launch and a clean transition to ongoing operations.

Finally, you will reimagine how we scale our ability to deliver this work through innovative, AI-native solutions. 

As a Director, GTM Operations, you will...
- Own end-to-end go-to-market coordination and delivery for Audible's membership portfolio transformation, managing the master GTM project plan across major product launches spanning multiple marketplaces

- Serve as the primary liaison to CEO-Directs and senior leadership, providing clear, concise status reporting against milestones, convening executives for strategic reviews, and ensuring leadership feedback is captured and incorporated into plans

- Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability across Product Marketing, Marketing channel owners, and measurement partners — building consensus and driving teams to committed dates without direct management authority

- Track and ensure marketplace launch readiness across all regions, working right-to-left from committed launch dates to confirm functional teams are on schedule, dependencies are visible, localization is effective, and regulatory/compliance requirements are met in every marketplace

- Ensure messaging and content consistency across the full customer journey — partnering with channel owners to maintain coherent, approved messaging across O&O surfaces, paid/social channels, PR/Comms toolkits, and customer service materials, while securing Legal sign-off to manage regulatory and reputational risk

- Proactively surface risks, delays, and blockers with sufficient lead time for leadership to act escalating to functional leaders or CEO-Directs when workstreams fall behind committed dates, and driving resolution of marketplace-specific gaps before activation

- Partner with Finance, Economics, and Analytics teams to produce and socialize measurement plans tied to clearly defined launch objectives, and coordinate performance reporting and executive communications through the post-launch period into formal BAU transition

- Maintain a global portfolio view across all in-scope launches, tracking cross-initiative dependencies, running recurring cross-functional meetings (project kickoffs, GTM planning sessions, readiness reviews with go/no-go decisions), and ensuring the end-to-end customer experience holds together across this evolution

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

- 10+ years in marketing, product marketing, go-to-market strategy, marketing operations, or program management in a consumer-facing or subscription-based business

- Experience driving cross-functional accountability across teams you don't directly manage — through influence, credibility, and structured program management

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

• Navigate internal tools and use MS Office (especially Excel) to track, analyze, and manage data workflows
• Make sound decisions when handling ambiguous or incomplete information
• Adapt to changing priorities, volume spikes, and task transitions without impacting metrics
• Participate in training and cross-skilling across multiple tasks
• Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements, including automation and process enhancements
• Work in rotational shifts within a 24/7 environment with weekly offs on any two days

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written English communication skills
- 0-5 years of work experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
- Analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage repetitive tasks across different workflows with high accuracy

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in operations or SOP-driven environments
- Familiarity with quality metrics and audit processes
- Ability to handle multiple tasks with quick turnaround times

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

- Advocating for the brand, the design organization, and your team across Amazon's broader partner ecosystem.
- Managing multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining high creative standards against tight deadlines.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Have an online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and advertising experience across a range of media and platforms, along with work that reflects your design process
- Bachelor’s degree in design, Fine Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Deep understanding of typography, layout, grid, and design principles across digital and print.
- Experience designing transformative interactive experiences: front-end UI, narrative storytelling, systems thinking, prototyping, and production-ready assets.
- Proficiency in Figma, InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
- Strong art direction skills and background — experience concepting, directing, and executing photo and video shoots, and developing brand image systems from initial vision through final production assets.
- Experience creating brand guidelines and developing O&O digital campaigns at global scale.
- Understanding of motion design principles and how they integrate into brand systems.
- Experience working with world-class brand-focused design agencies or consultancies.
- Unwavering dedication to craft from first idea to final execution.
- Familiarity with the evolving AI landscape as it applies to design — including awareness of generative image and video tools, AI-assisted workflows, and emerging best practices — with a thoughtful point of view on how these tools can raise the creative bar without compromising craft or brand integrity.

title: Production Test Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Project Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Production Test Engineer will support test operators and operations by coordinating, maintaining, and improving testing hardware and software capabilities for a variety of different propulsion subsystems: PCBAs, feed systems, electric propulsion thrusters, tanks, and integrated propulsion systems.

The Propulsion Test Engineer will support existing test processes and hardware in order to ensure the needed test coverage is achieved at production rates. This will include coordinating tests, training test operators, resolving test nonconformances, building up additional test stations, and implementing methods of optimizing testing.

descriptionHtml:

As we rapidly become the world’s largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Procurement team is fueling our explosive growth by identifying innovative sourcing strategies and negotiating sustainable, long-term partnerships.

We are seeking a skilled Strategic Sourcing Manager with experience leading complex sourcing initiatives across Indirect categories. Key leadership traits required include the ability to influence and form partnerships with business leaders, and operational excellence in managing multiple complex and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strategic Sourcing Manager are expert practitioners in the tools for creating competitive environments, and have a bias for decision-making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence vendor relationships by advising Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business goals. If you are looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company, come make history with Amazon’s Corporate Procurement department.

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. descriptionHtml:
PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POSITION REQUIRES RELOCATION TO POLAND (GDANSK).

Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our team in Gdansk. You will work on firmware for IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, developing new features and shipping products from concept to production.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of firmware subsystems running on resource-constrained hardware. You will work across the full development cycle: architecture, implementation, code review, testing on real devices, and production release. Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture.

The ideal candidate:

Has shipped embedded products to production and understands what it takes to go from prototype to millions of devices in the field.
Writes clean, maintainable C/C++ for constrained environments and cares deeply about code quality.
Communicates proactively, raises technical risks early, and drives solutions across teams.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as customer needs evolve.
Is curious about the full stack, from hardware registers to cloud connectivity, and enjoys learning new domains.

Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices.
Specify and implement functionality for embedded subsystems (connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security).
Collaborate with hardware, QA, cloud, and app teams to deliver integrated product experiences.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-team architecture decisions.
Debug complex issues across hardware and software boundaries using JTAG, UART, and protocol analyzers.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a code change from a colleague working on a new sensor driver. After your team standup, you spend focused time implementing a feature for an upcoming product launch, testing it on real hardware at your desk. In the afternoon, you dig into a tricky issue that only reproduces on one board variant, tracing it from application code down to a register misconfiguration. You push your fix, verify it on the device, and close the day knowing it will ship to customers in the next release.
Internal job description

- BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Extensive experience in computer architecture and embedded wireless systems

- Extensive experience with writing low-level drivers, interrupt service routines and general troubleshooting/debugging with hardware

- Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Program Manager III, Amazon Credito
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building a consumer credit product in Mexico that will give millions of customers flexible, affordable ways to shop. We are looking for a Program Manager III to join our International Emerging Payments team and drive the cross-functional execution of this early-stage business from launch through scale. You will own the program plan, connect workstreams across product, technology, risk, operations, finance, legal, compliance, marketing, and customer service, and build the mechanisms, controls, and processes that do not exist yet. If you are a resourceful, data-driven program manager who is skilled at prioritization and stakeholder management and wants to shape a new business from the ground up, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end program plan for Amazon Credit in Mexico, including milestone tracking, critical path analysis, and workstream-level delivery timelines across product, technology, risk, operations, finance, legal, compliance, marketing, and customer service teams.
- Drive stakeholder alignment by leading weekly program meetings, preparing leadership-level status updates, and managing escalations, dependencies, and scope changes through structured governance processes.
- Build and maintain program dashboards, risk registers, and reporting mechanisms that give leadership clear visibility into program health and progress. Use AI tools to augment analysis, improve reporting quality, and accelerate decision-making.
- Partner with Amazon Credit teams in other geographies and central platform teams to identify synergies, share learnings, and align on shared versus local requirements.
- Drive operational readiness for each launch phase by ensuring standard operating procedures are documented, teams are trained, and testing is completed across all workstreams.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing program metrics and running a standup with your project teams to clear blockers and confirm the week's priorities. By midday, you could be leading a working session with product managers, risk analysts, and operations leads to align on requirements for an upcoming milestone. Later, you might prepare a business review narrative for senior leadership or coordinate with Amazon Credit teams in other countries to compare approaches. Because this is an early-stage business, you will regularly design new processes and controls rather than follow existing playbooks.

About the team
The MX Payments team, part of Amazon's International Emerging Payments organization, manages the local payment experience for physical and digital offerings on the Amazon Mexico store. Our mission is to design payment experiences that increase access, affordability, and customer trust. Amazon Credito is an early-stage business, so you will join a collaborative, hands-on group where your work directly shapes how the product scales. As the business grows, you will have opportunities to engage with the broader fintech ecosystem in Mexico, connect with Payments teams across emerging markets, and take on additional products that expand the scope and complexity of your role.
